text: [ job - 32719] Sênior AI Developer ( Java + Angular ), Brazil
descriptionBodyPlain:
Buscamos uma pessoa com forte experiência técnica, autonomia para resolver problemas complexos e interesse em desenvolver soluções inovadoras com Inteligência Artificial.
Esperamos alguém que tenha experiência prática na construção de agentes inteligentes, skills e soluções de IA, boa comunicação e facilidade para colaborar com diferentes times. Curiosidade, protagonismo e vontade de aprender também fazem parte desse desafio!
Sua missão
Atuar como referência técnica na construção e evolução de soluções de IA e automação, contribuindo diretamente para a produtividade, qualidade informacional e evolução das plataformas que suportam o negócio.
Principais responsabilidades
Desenvolver agentes inteligentes e skills para apoiar processos de curadoria, publicação e gestão de conteúdo.
Construir integrações entre plataformas, APIs e serviços corporativos.
Evoluir taxonomias e ferramentas de leitura, classificação e análise de conversas.
Desenvolver soluções de IA voltadas à produtividade e disponibilização de novas capacidades para o negócio.
Atuar com autonomia na identificação de problemas, definição de soluções e implementação técnica.
Contribuir com iniciativas de qualidade informacional, agentes inteligentes e evolução da base de conhecimento.
O que esperamos de você:
Experiência com desenvolvimento Java.
Experiência prática na criação e implementação de agentes inteligentes e skills.
Conhecimento em APIs REST, incluindo design, consumo e integração.
Experiência na avaliação da qualidade de soluções com LLMs, incluindo evals, guardrails e observabilidade (tracing, custos e latência).
Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e integração entre sistemas, utilizando filas e eventos.
Experiência com Git para versionamento e colaboração em código.
Boa comunicação, autonomia e facilidade de colaboração com o time.
Será um diferencial:
Experiência com frameworks de agentes, como LangChain, LangGraph ou CrewAI, e protocolos como MCP e tool calling.
Experiência com LLMs aplicados à classificação, extração e análise de conversas e textos, incluindo construção e evolução de taxonomias.
Conhecimento em práticas DevOps, infraestrutura como código (IaC) e containers.
Se você gosta de desafios técnicos, inovação e construção de soluções inteligentes com impacto real no negócio, queremos conhecer você!

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are seeking a highly skilled Master Software Developer with a strong background in backend architecture and experience in integrating generative AI tools into client products. The ideal candidate will have proficiency in Python, C# or Java, thrive in a complex work environment with multiple stakeholders, and possess excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with both team members and clients. Fluency in English is essential for daily interactions and intensive discussions.

Key Responsibilities:
Backend Development: Design, implement, and maintain robust and scalable backend architecture using Python.
Generative AI Integration: Leverage generative AI technologies to enhance client products, providing innovative solutions and tools. 
Knowledge on Generative AI technical stacks and strategies (LLMs, RAG, Fine Tunning, Chain of Thought, etc.) and how to embed them into client’s products.
Client Communication: Engage with clients to understand their requirements, provide regular updates, and gather feedback to refine product features.
Code Quality and Best Practices: Ensure code maintainability, readability, and performance by adhering to best practices and conducting code reviews.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for backend services and generative AI integrations.

Qualifications:
Education: 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in development using Python, C# or Java.  
Proven experience in backend architecture design and implementation.  
Familiarity with generative AI technologies and their application in product development.

Technical Skills:  
Proficient in Python  
Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and database management (SQL and NoSQL).  
Experience with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).  
Knowledge of machine learning concepts and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) is a plus.

Soft Skills:  
Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (both written and verbal).  -

descriptionBodyPlain:
We're looking for a Senior Client Director to join our expanding EMEA region to act as the commercial leader of a portfolio of strategic client accounts that is responsible for accelerating the profitable growth by expanding engagements, relationships & measurable business value. 
 
This role will act as the CEO of the accounts, giving autonomy to grow & run the accounts by planning & executing the strategy to embed themselves by bringing together the technology strategy, delivery, data, AI, marketing, partnerships & new business.
 
This position will require you to be onsite in CI&T's London office/client's offices a minimum of 3 days a week, depending on client need.
 
The Key Responsibilities of this role are:
 
Own the Account Strategy
Develop & execute strategic account growth plans aligned the the clients and CI&T's objectives
Lead the client Strategy Group
Act as commercial owner across a portfolio of strategic accounts
Drive the Commercial Growth
Deliver 20%+ year on year growth across your accounts
Lead commercial strategy & solutions
Partner with the new business director around a shared growth plan
Build Executive Relationships
Establish trusted relationships across C-Suite & senior stakeholders
Lead business reviews, strategic governance & transformation discussions
Develop deep client intelligence to shape long term engagements
Champion Delivery Excellence
Own the overall commercial performance, forecasting and profitability on your portfolio
Build efficient partnerships with the delivery leaders to ensure the programmes deliver measurable business outcomes
Act as the escalation point for client engagements
Lead Collaboration
Bring together CI&T's teams to build solutions to complex issues within the client
Coordinate executive engagements and thought leadership
Share market insights with the wider team
 
What we're looking for:
Strong commercial experience within a technology consultancy or similar with a proven track record of growing accounts and delivering measurable year on year growth
Confident in stakeholder management to C-level
Expert in recognising opportunities, qualifying them and strategically planning accounts
Ability to connect business insights to strategic growth
Excellent presentation skills and object handling
Experienced in working with nearshore and offshore delivery teams
Can lead complex, global technology and business change for critical enterprise platforms

descriptionBodyPlain:
About the Role
We’re looking for an experienced and commercially minded Senior HR Business Partner to join our People & Culture team and partner closely with senior leaders across EMEA.
This is a high-impact, hands-on role for an HR professional who thrives in fast-paced, evolving environments and enjoys operating at both a strategic and operational level. You’ll play a key role in translating business priorities into people strategies that enable growth, strengthen organisational culture and deliver measurable business outcomes.
With teams across the UK, Portugal and Brazil, you’ll bring a strong understanding of working across different cultures and markets, while helping the organisation navigate transformation and change.
You’ll have the opportunity to influence leadership decisions, shape organisational design, develop talent and succession pipelines, strengthen performance management, and lead initiatives that enhance the overall employee experience.
What You’ll Do
Partner with Senior Leadership
Act as a trusted strategic partner to senior leaders across EMEA, providing insight and challenge on people, organisational structure, performance and workforce matters.
Translate business strategy and evolving priorities into practical People & Culture solutions.
Support leaders in making informed, people-focused decisions in a fast-moving environment.
Drive People Strategy & Transformation
Develop and deliver People & Culture initiatives that directly support business objectives and deliver measurable impact.
Lead and contribute to organisational transformation and change initiatives across the region.
Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, policies and ways of working, ensuring they remain agile and fit for purpose.
Lead Core HR Processes
Own and support end-to-end workforce planning and headcount management.
Drive succession planning and talent development pipelines.
Lead performance management cycles, including calibration and development planning.
Support employee engagement, culture and organisational effectiveness initiatives.
Use Data to Drive Decisions
Leverage people analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
Turn data and insights into clear recommendations for leaders.
Use evidence-based approaches to continuously improve people processes and employee experience across diverse teams.
Coach & Develop Leaders
Provide hands-on coaching to leaders on effective people management, feedback, performance, conflict resolution and leadership development.
Help leaders build high-performing, inclusive teams and foster a culture of open communication and continuous improvement.
Collaborate Across People & Culture
Work closely with Talent Acquisition, People Development, Compensation & Benefits and Culture teams.
Ensure HR policies, programmes and practices are aligned, consistent and responsive to the needs of the business and our people.
What We’re Looking For
You’ll bring:
Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, People Partner or strategic HR role, ideally within an organisation experiencing significant growth, transformation or change.
A strong track record of partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
A hands-on approach, with the ability to move confidently between strategic thinking and operational delivery.
Strong experience across performance management, talent development, succession planning and organisational culture.
Excellent commercial and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people solutions.
Experience working across different countries, cultures and organisational contexts within EMEA.
A strong analytical mindset, with experience using people data, HR metrics and reporting to inform decisions and improve processes.
Exceptional communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
The ability to build trusted relationships at all levels and confidently challenge and coach senior leaders.
A proven ability to operate effectively through ambiguity, change and evolving organisational priorities.
Nice to Have
Experience working within a technology, startup or high-growth environment.
Experience leading organisational transformation or change management initiatives across multiple regions.
Knowledge of Portuguese would be an advantage.

descriptionBodyPlain:
Estamos em busca de um desenvolvedor Java Master/Sênior para atuar em grande frente junto a AWS, você irá construir as camadas de capacidade de negócio de uma plataforma bancária moderna, centralizando regras de negócio e autorização que hoje vivem espalhadas em sistemas legados. Você vai desenvolver microsserviços de domínio que unificam a lógica transacional, implementar padrões de integração (adapters) para conectar o ambiente legado à nova plataforma e garantir, através de validações de equivalência e reconciliação, que a migração aconteça sem qualquer regressão. Ideal para quem gosta de modelar domínios complexos e entregar backend confiável em cenários onde consistência e compliance são inegociáveis.
Experiência em:
Desenvolvimento backend em Java (Spring Boot ou equivalente) para microsserviços de domínio.
Implementação de motores de regras de negócio e de autorização.
Padrões de integração (adapter / anti-corruption layer) entre sistemas legado e plataformas modernas.
Deploy em Kubernetes/EKS e desenvolvimento de fluxos transacionais.
Testes de equivalência, reconciliação e validação de carga.
Conhecimentos em:
AWS (EKS, ECR).
Padrões de arquitetura do setor financeiro (ex.: BIAN).
Compliance e trilhas de auditoria no setor financeiro.
Integração com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL.
Diferencial:
Certificações AWS: AWS Certified Developer – Associate e/ou AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate."

As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)
Familiarity with recommendation systems or ranking/weighting logic for content surfacing

descriptionBodyPlain:
CI&T is looking for a Senior Data Architect specialized in integrations to join a modernization initiative for a leading client in the digital commerce industry. This is a strategic role: the person hired will be the technical reference responsible for unifying data across core business systems — ERP, CRM, finance, and inventory management — and the client's customer-facing platform, ensuring that critical information, such as revenue figures, flows consistently and reliably across the entire operation.
The scope of this position covers the full integration lifecycle: from architecture design to implementation, governance, and continuous optimization of data flows. The role combines deep technical expertise in the integration platform with a data governance mindset, and includes direct collaboration with enterprise architects, product owners, and ERP functional consultants to translate business needs into robust, scalable integration solutions.
Responsibilities:
Designs and documents end-to-end integration architecture, defining real-time, batch, and event-driven communication patterns across legacy systems, e-commerce platforms, SaaS ecosystems, and microservices.
Develops and optimizes integration flows between the integration platform and the client's ERP, leveraging native connectors and multiple connection points to ensure reliable data synchronization.
Defines development best practices, naming standards, and component reuse, ensuring consistency and maintainability across integration teams.
Establishes centralized logging, auditing, and exception-handling strategies, enabling full traceability of business-critical data flows.
Performs infrastructure sizing for the integration platform, optimizing concurrency, rate limiting, and resource consumption to ensure performance at scale.
Manages the promotion of integration processes across environments (development, QA, and production) and version control, through structured deployment practices.
Provides technical leadership to the development team by conducting code reviews and mentoring, ensuring adherence to the organization's architecture guidelines.
Collaborates directly with product owners, enterprise architects, and ERP functional specialists to map data requirements and translate them into efficient integration flows.
Assesses and proposes the inclusion of master data governance practices within the integration architecture, preventing discrepancies in business-critical metrics.
Requirements:
Proven experience designing and implementing enterprise integration architectures (middleware, ESB, or iPaaS).
Deep, hands-on expertise with the Boomi integration platform (AtomSphere, API Management, Atom/Molecule, EDI/B2B) — mandatory requirement.
Experience integrating customer-facing systems (ERP, CRM, e-commerce) through connectors and APIs, with the ability to work across multiple simultaneous connection points.
Solid knowledge of scripting languages used within the integration platform (Groovy or JavaScript) for advanced data manipulation and complex mapping.
Strong command of data standards and formats (REST, SOAP, Webhooks, JSON, XML, XSLT, SQL) and authentication/security protocols (OAuth 2.0, JWT, TLS/SSL).
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), for direct communication with the client's international technical leadership.
Assertive communication skills, able to engage effectively with both technical teams and business executives.
Systemic thinking and strong analytical skills to solve complex data synchronization and concurrency challenges.
Nice to Have:
Experience with the Oracle NetSuite ERP, including SuiteTalk APIs (SOAP/REST), RESTlets, SuiteScript, or SuiteQL.
Official certifications in the Boomi platform (Integration Developer, Integration Architect, or API Design).
Experience with master data management tools, including the integration platform's own Data Hub capabilities.
Functional knowledge of ERP modules related to Finance, Supply Chain, Order Management, or CRM.
Familiarity with monitoring and APM tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, Dynatrace).
Proactive mindset to propose improvements to legacy processes and adopt emerging technologies.

As CI&T grows its Data & Analytics Center of Excellence, we seek a talented and experienced Graph Database Developer to join a specialized team building an AI-powered fashion advisory platform for a leading client in the fashion and retail industry. This role is central to turning unstructured editorial content into a structured knowledge graph that powers real-time, intelligent style recommendations for end users attending formal events.
The Graph Database Developer will work in a staff augmentation model, integrating with a cross-functional team that includes a Machine Learning Developer and a GenAI Agent Developer. This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong ownership of the graph data layer — from schema design through ingestion, entity resolution, and query performance — with direct impact on what the AI agent recommends to users.
Responsibilities:
Schema Design: Define node labels and edge types that represent the relationships between designers, garments, style attributes, trends, occasions, and editorial articles.
Entity Ingestion: Build workflows that consume structured JSON payloads from the upstream data pipeline and load them into the graph database in batch mode.
Probabilistic Entity Matching: Match extracted item mentions (for example, a bag described by type, color, and material) to the correct product node in a catalog of 50,000+ SKUs by scoring attribute overlap, assigning a match confidence, and creating the relationship only when it exceeds a defined threshold. Deduplicate items that appear inconsistently across different articles.
Editorial Signal Weighting: Assign weights to relationships based on how prominently an item or trend was featured, distinguishing a dedicated feature from a passing mention. These weights determine what the AI agent surfaces first in its recommendations.
Query Optimization: Design and tune openCypher traversal queries, including multi-hop queries, to return relevant results in under three seconds for downstream Amazon Bedrock Agents.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside the Machine Learning Developer and GenAI Agent Developer to align the graph structure with the retrieval and recommendation needs of the AI agent.
Technical Validation: Support technical interviews and validation of new team members joining the graph database workstream, as needed.
Requirements:
Advanced English proficiency (C1 or above), with autonomy to communicate directly with international stakeholders
Solid experience with the property graph data model
Experience writing and optimizing openCypher queries, including multi-hop traversals under latency constraints
Experience designing graph schemas, evaluating trade-offs between different modeling approaches
Experience building entity resolution logic, including fuzzy matching, scoring algorithms, and deduplication across data sources
Strong Python skills for data engineering, including batch processing of structured data payloads
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, staff augmentation setting with an established client team
 
Nice to Have:
Solid experience with Amazon Neptune
Prior experience in fashion, retail, or e-commerce catalogs
AWS certification in databases or data analytics
Experience integrating graph databases with generative AI agents (for example, Amazon Bedrock Agents)
Familiarity with recommendation systems or ranking/weighting logic for content surfacing

descriptionBodyPlain:
About the opportunity
We are looking for a Tech Lead/Architect (.NET + Azure) to join an international project. In this role, you will be the technical leader of the team: a highly experienced professional who guides technical direction, solves problems together with the team, and is able to implement solutions when needed. We want someone who enjoys sharing knowledge and contributing to CI&T and the community. We value cultural fit, respect for differences, collaboration, and teamwork.
 
What your day-to-day will look like
As the technical leader of the team, you will be responsible for:
Being an accessible technical reference for the developers, QA, and support teams, assisting and guiding them whenever they need support
Getting hands-on and implementing solutions when needed, especially when the team requires support to deliver changes
Leading the technical response to severe production incidents, from diagnosis to verified resolution
Guiding architectural and technical decisions, documenting the significant ones, to keep the solution scalable, secure, and sustainable
Solving complex problems together with the team, bringing the right people together to find the best solution
Reviewing technical solutions and promoting good programming and architecture practices
Helping keep the backlog well-defined and taking part in refinement sessions
Driving continuous improvements on an established solution
Keeping code quality and security findings visible and remediated within agreed SLAs
Defining and evolving technical standards
Following .NET and Azure trends and bringing in the ones that make sense for the project
Partnering with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
Communicating in English with the client’s technical experts when needed
Translating business needs into technical options and decisions
 
What you should have
Strong, in-depth experience in C# and modern .NET versions, including ASP.NET Core MVC Razor
Working knowledge of Azure and DevOps practices, enough to partner with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
High level of seniority, still hands-on and able to implement solutions
Experience in guiding teams and driving technical decisions
Proven ability to solve complex problems collaboratively, involving the right people and sharing the challenge with the team instead of working in isolation
Leadership soft skills to align people, encourage collaboration, and drive solutions together
Experience driving continuous improvements and technical standards
Experience with databases, version control, cloud, and CI/CD tools
Experience with automated testing, code review practices, and static analysis tools, including remediating code quality and security findings
Experience troubleshooting production issues and handling incidents
Good judgment to prioritize and to raise technical risks early
Experience or ability to work with development, QA, and support activities
Excellent communication skills, both technical and business-related, including clear written documentation
Advanced or fluent English

Na CI&T, estamos em busca de um(a)Sr. Developer  (.Net) altamente qualificado(a) e motivado(a) para se juntar à nossa equipe no Brasil. Você contribuirá para um projeto inovador em um ambiente colaborativo, inovador, transformador e multicultural.

• Experiência com banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL ou SQL Server). 
• Conhecimento em Docker e docker-compose. 
• Conhecimento em observabilidade (logs, métricas e tracing) com ferramentas como Datadog, Grafana ou ELK. 
• Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Service Bus). 
• Inglês: Intermediário 
Diferenciais: 
• Experiência prática no uso de ferramentas de IA para desenvolvimento de software (ex: OpenAI APIs, Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, etc.) 
• Experiência em construção de agentes autônomos ou semi-autônomos para desenvolvimento de software. 
• Experiência com pipelines de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (ex: geração de código, testes, refatoração automática). 
• Conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e avaliação de qualidade de outputs de modelos de IA.

descriptionBodyPlain:
As CI&T grows, we seek a talented, motivated, and experienced Data & Analytics Manager to join our team and lead data-driven solutions for our customers. This role is pivotal in balancing strategic management with hands-on execution, ensuring that our data initiatives are not only well-planned but also effectively implemented.
 
The Data & Analytics Manager will oversee the entire lifecycle of data products, from ideation and development to deployment and optimization. This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, critical analysis, and leadership skills to drive the successful execution of data-driven initiatives while also being actively involved in day-to-day operations. You will be responsible for the tracking strategy of one of the biggest e-commerces in Mexico, it will require your ability to translate behavior metrics into business insights and data visualizations that feed and drive marketing and product initiatives.
 
Responsibilities:
 
Data Analysis: Provide data analysis that supports business and digital product growth through data visualization.
Team Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams, including data scientists, engineers, and analytics specialists, to develop and deliver high-quality data products. Attract, retain, and develop top data talents while mentoring and training to foster growth and motivation within the team.
Task Prioritization: Collaborate with technical and business teams to understand their data needs and priorities, effectively communicating the value of data initiatives. Prioritize tasks and define the roadmap, balancing competing demands from different stakeholders.
Data Profiling: Analyze data types, relationships, patterns, and trends to enhance data understanding.
Requirements Definition: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to articulate clear, specific, and achievable data requirements, including how data should be presented for consumption.
Business Process Understanding: Grasp business workflows to make informed assumptions regarding sources, entities, and attributes that answer business questions.
Validation: Validate products with users to ensure they meet needs and expectations, leveraging data and metrics to inform decisions.
Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze product performance using metrics and KPIs to assess success, tracking the effectiveness of data initiatives and investments, and using data-driven insights for continuous improvement.
Data Governance: 
Data Architecture & Infrastructure: Understand the technical architecture/infrastructure that supports the organization's data needs, including storage, integrations, and analytics platforms for e-commerces.
Powered by AI: Support the incorporation of AI in team workflows to enhance performance.
 
Requirements:
Excellent level of English C1 or above 
Experience working with international clients
Experience with major Cloud Platform providers (Azure, AWS, or GCP)
Experience with data platforms (Databricks or Snowflake)
Strong strategic thinking and product mindset
Experience with value-based prioritization
Proven team leadership skills with a hands-on approach
Nice to Have:
Experience in either the Data Platform, Data Visualization, or Advanced Analytics space
Experience with on-prem and data cloud migration 
Experience with project management tools 
Experience with AI/ML
Spanish language (reading, writing, and speaking)

descriptionBodyPlain:
About the opportunity
We are looking for a Tech Lead/Architect (.NET + Azure) to join an international project. In this role, you will be the technical leader of the team: a highly experienced professional who guides technical direction, solves problems together with the team, and is able to implement solutions when needed. We want someone who enjoys sharing knowledge and contributing to CI&T and the community. We value cultural fit, respect for differences, collaboration, and teamwork.
 
What your day-to-day will look like
As the technical leader of the team, you will be responsible for:
Being an accessible technical reference for the developers, QA, and support teams, assisting and guiding them whenever they need support
Getting hands-on and implementing solutions when needed, especially when the team requires support to deliver changes
Leading the technical response to severe production incidents, from diagnosis to verified resolution
Guiding architectural and technical decisions, documenting the significant ones, to keep the solution scalable, secure, and sustainable
Solving complex problems together with the team, bringing the right people together to find the best solution
Reviewing technical solutions and promoting good programming and architecture practices
Helping keep the backlog well-defined and taking part in refinement sessions
Driving continuous improvements on an established solution
Keeping code quality and security findings visible and remediated within agreed SLAs
Defining and evolving technical standards
Following .NET and Azure trends and bringing in the ones that make sense for the project
Partnering with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
Communicating in English with the client’s technical experts when needed
Translating business needs into technical options and decisions
 
What you should have
Strong, in-depth experience in C# and modern .NET versions, including ASP.NET Core MVC Razor
Working knowledge of Azure and DevOps practices, enough to partner with DevOps on application changes that affect operations
High level of seniority, still hands-on and able to implement solutions
Experience in guiding teams and driving technical decisions
Proven ability to solve complex problems collaboratively, involving the right people and sharing the challenge with the team instead of working in isolation
Leadership soft skills to align people, encourage collaboration, and drive solutions together
Experience driving continuous improvements and technical standards
Experience with databases, version control, cloud, and CI/CD tools
Experience with automated testing, code review practices, and static analysis tools, including remediating code quality and security findings
Experience troubleshooting production issues and handling incidents
Good judgment to prioritize and to raise technical risks early
Experience or ability to work with development, QA, and support activities
Excellent communication skills, both technical and business-related, including clear written documentation
Advanced or fluent English

descriptionBodyPlain:
Olá, aqui é a Tamara da CI&T!

Sobre a oportunidade de AI Engineer/Software Architect:

A CI&T está montando um novo programa: para modernizar um legado do nosso cliente e levar todas as jornadas do Portal do Cliente para a arquitetura nova. 
 
Esta é uma posição sênior e hands-on. Você será a referência técnica em engenharia assistida por IA dentro da sua frente. Seu papel é transformar a IA em vantagem concreta de prazo e qualidade em um cenário de legado pouco documentado, com muitas integrações e meta de desligamento agressiva.
O que você vai fazer:
Responder pela entrega técnica da frente, garantindo qualidade, previsibilidade e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais: React com micro-frontend, NodeJS, em EKS/AWS e Cognito.
Conduzir a engenharia reversa do legado assistida por IA, extraindo do código (.do, .jsp, .aspx) a hierarquia de telas, as regras de negócio e os serviços consumidos.
Transformar esse conhecimento em especificações e documentação viva, usando Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit, BMAD) como base, já que hoje as regras só existem no handoff do Figma.
Desenvolver e acelerar a migração das telas, isolando as integrações legadas em adapters no BFF e reaproveitando componentes comuns entre produtos.
Implementar processos agênticos ao longo do fluxo da frente: code review com IA, geração e manutenção de testes, refatoração assistida e automação de PRs.
Apoiar o IA Orchestrator e a PO no refinamento técnico e na organização do backlog, estimando fluxos (P/M/G/GG), sinalizando riscos e priorizando oportunidades de automação.
Avaliar trade-offs de integração entre front, BFF e gateways (Flex Gateway/MuleSoft), considerando as dependências com outras equipes da Porto.
Mentorar os engenheiros da frente e elevar a maturidade do time em desenvolvimento com Claude Code e ferramentas agênticas.
O que esperamos de você:
Experiência prática profunda com ferramentas agênticas de desenvolvimento, em particular Claude Code.
Domínio de Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit e/ou BMAD) e capacidade de aplicá-lo a projetos de migração e modernização.
Vivência sólida full stack com React/Next.js e Node, e com arquitetura de micro-frontends e BFF.
Experiência com migração ou modernização de sistemas legados, de preferência Java web (JSP/Struts ou similares).
Uso de IA para entender código legado: engenharia reversa, extração de regras de negócio e mapeamento de dependências.
Repertório em processos agênticos aplicados ao desenvolvimento, como code review com IA, agentes para QA e automações de pipeline.
Visão sistêmica para enxergar arquitetura, dependências e impactos entre times e sistemas.
Experiência em refinamento técnico junto a Product Owners e responsabilidade direta pela entrega técnica de um time.
Diferenciais;
Vivência com AWS (EKS, Cognito) e com gateways de API (MuleSoft/Flex Gateway).
Vivência com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e construção de agentes customizados para fluxos de engenharia.

Visão sistêmica para enxergar arquitetura, dependências e impactos entre times e sistemas.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are hiring a Senior Backend Developer to join a cross-functional team working in the alcoholic beverage industry. We operate a B2B e-commerce platform that is active in 30 countries and serves as one of our largest partnerships.
In this role, you will work on a managed integration platform. Your job is to connect our partners’ main business systems (ERP, CRM, OMS, WMS) to our global e-commerce platform. You will extract data about products, customers, pricing, inventory, orders, and fulfilment from these systems and ensure it reaches the downstream platform reliably.
You will work across the entire project lifecycle — building solutions, deploying them, supporting urgent issues (hypercare), and providing ongoing operations. You will also participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to handle escalations and production issues. This is a heavily customer-facing role, so you will partner closely with partner technical teams throughout.
You will use AI coding agents as a core part of your daily work — this is not optional. You will evaluate AI-generated code critically to catch errors and ensure quality.
What You Will Do
Design and deliver integration solutions that connect partner systems (ERP, CRM, OMS, WMS) to the global e-commerce platform
Own the complete data integration flow: extract data, transform it, map it, validate it, check accuracy, and deliver it downstream
Lead technical conversations with partner teams across the entire project lifecycle
Build, test, deploy, and operate integrations that handle commercial, customer, product, pricing, inventory, order, and fulfilment data
Use observability practices: logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and runbooks to ensure high-quality integrations with low defect rates
Handle new-partner onboarding, build, deployment, and steady-state operations (with balance determined by leadership)
Participate in 24/7 L3 on-call rotation (24-hour shifts, rotating daily; respecting legally required rest between shifts)
Troubleshoot production incidents and make technical decisions under pressure with incomplete information
Use AI coding agents as your primary delivery tool, critically evaluating AI output for accuracy
Utilize best tools and technologies to refine integration development and operations practices
What You Need to Know
Senior experience designing, delivering, and operating integrations between enterprise systems (ERP/CRM) and commerce platforms
Strong knowledge of the complete data integration flow end-to-end: extraction, transformation, mapping, validation, reconciliation, ingestion, and delivery
Experience with multiple integration methods: REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, event streaming, file exchange (SFTP), middleware, ETL/ELT tools, and batch processing
Java backend development (production-level experience)
Azure Data Factory
REST APIs
Spring Boot (Spring MVC, Spring Security, production-depth)
Message brokers (RabbitMQ or equivalent)
PostgreSQL
Docker and Kubernetes
Testing (JUnit, end-to-end tests)
Observability discipline (logging, distributed tracing, alerting, runbooks)
Customer-facing maturity — comfortable leading technical conversations with partner teams
Ability to work effectively under pressure (production incidents, urgent issues, customer-visible outages)
AI-native engineering (required, not optional) — daily, fluent use of AI coding agents as your primary delivery tool, with critical evaluation of AI output
Advanced English proficiency, fluent in technical meetings with external stakeholders

text: [Job - 32599] Senior CMS Developer (Adobe Experience Platform), Brazil
descriptionBodyPlain:
About the Project
A project for a global pharmaceutical company, focused on evolving a continuing medical education content library into an engagement platform for healthcare professionals beyond the reach of traditional field teams — personalized, orchestrated in real time, and providing professional recognition.
The Martech team is building the engine behind this personalization using Adobe Experience Cloud: unified identity, real-time profiles, email and WhatsApp journeys, experimentation, and analytics, with CRM integration (Veeva preferred) and compliance with Brazil's LGPD data protection law.
Engagement duration: 2 years, with an expected start date in November 2026.
Position Mission
Build and maintain, hands-on, what the architecture defines: schemas, data ingestion, audiences, journeys, experiments, and reports within Adobe, from data layer specification through results analysis.
This is the person responsible for making the platform work end-to-end and serving as the go-to technical resource for the client's team whenever something needs to be validated or explained.
How success in this role is measured:
Audiences and journeys delivered and validated end-to-end (event → profile → segment → trigger → report) before each release.
Data layer specified and implemented without requiring front-end rework.
Experiments designed using sound statistical methodologies, with results analyzed through CJA/Target.
Sufficient technical documentation to ensure the support team can operate independently, without relying on this individual.
Responsibilities
Define the data layer and data collection strategy (events, properties, identities, and consent) in collaboration with Design and Front-end teams; implement through Adobe Tags and Web SDK.
Configure Adobe Experience Platform (AEP): XDM schemas, datasets, identities, batch and streaming ingestion, and data governance policies.
Build audiences in Real-Time CDP (specialty × engagement level × behavior) and activate them across destinations.
Build and maintain journeys in Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) for email and WhatsApp, including triggers, conditions, frequency, consent-based suppression, and templates.
Design and structure experiments in Adobe Target: A/B testing, multivariate testing, and experience targeting, including form-based personalization and decision scopes.
Create and maintain reports and workspaces in Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), including marketing channel configurations and calculated metrics.
Develop and maintain CRM (Veeva preferred) and API integrations, including data mapping, scheduling, error handling, and reconciliation.
Perform end-to-end validations and data QA for every release; provide ongoing platform support and investigate incidents.
Analyze journey and experiment results and propose improvements in collaboration with Product and Design teams.
Produce technical documentation (configurations, event dictionaries, and runbooks) and support the squad's mid-level developer.
Requirements
Must-have qualifications
Experience in Martech development or implementation, including at least 2 years working with Adobe Experience Cloud.
Hands-on experience with:
Adobe Experience Platform (AEP): schemas, identity, and data ingestion.
Real-Time CDP: audience creation.
Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO): email and WhatsApp journeys.
Adobe Target: form-based personalization and decision scopes.
Customer Journey Analytics (CJA): reporting and marketing channels.
Adobe Data Collection: Tags and Web SDK.
Experience integrating CRM platforms and REST APIs; Veeva experience is a strong preference.
Experience defining data layers and data collection strategies, as well as validating implementations using debugging tools (Adobe Experience Platform Debugger and Assurance).
Ability to design and analyze experiments, including A/B testing, multivariate testing, and experience targeting.
Sufficient front-end knowledge to implement tracking and troubleshoot issues: JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Clear technical documentation skills.
Native Portuguese and intermediate-to-advanced English proficiency (for Adobe documentation and technical support).
Nice-to-have qualifications
Adobe certifications (AEP Developer, AJO, Target, CJA).
Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, particularly with consent management and LGPD compliance for channel activation.
Experience with WhatsApp Business API as a channel within AJO.
SQL and AEP Query Service knowledge for data validation and analysis.
Knowledge of Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or another headless CMS for personalized content integration.

descriptionBodyPlain:
About the Project
A project for a global pharmaceutical company, focused on evolving a continuing medical education content library into an engagement platform for healthcare professionals beyond the reach of traditional field teams — personalized, orchestrated in real time, and providing professional recognition.
The CMS team is building the platform itself using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including micro-learning lessons, reference kits, clinical cases, patient materials, and search functionality across an approved content repository. The platform will feature mobile-first performance and integration with the personalization layer (AEP/Target).
Engagement duration: 2 years, with an expected start date in November 2026.
Position Mission
Define and maintain the platform architecture in AEM — including content models, delivery, integrations, security, and pipelines — ensuring that the client's medical content team can publish independently, healthcare professionals can load a page in less than 2 seconds on mobile devices, and every release passes security gates without unexpected issues.
This person will serve as the CMS squad's technical reference and work closely with the Martech Architect.
How success in this role is measured:
Architecture approved through platform and security gates and remaining stable throughout the project phases.
Core Web Vitals meeting mobile performance targets (LCP below 2.5 seconds) in production.
DevSecOps pipeline with automated builds, testing, security analysis, and deployments; zero manual deployments.
Content models that allow the client to create new lessons and materials without requiring development team intervention.
Responsibilities
Define the AEM reference architecture (AEM as a Cloud Service or Edge Delivery Services, depending on the platform decision), including content models and fragments, templates, components, and headless or hybrid delivery.
Design the delivery and caching strategy, including CDN, Dispatcher, cache invalidation, responsive images, and mobile-first performance.
Configure and maintain DevSecOps pipelines (Cloud Manager or equivalent), including builds, testing, static code and dependency analysis, environment promotion, and rollback.
Design platform integrations, including the personalization layer (AEP/Target/Web SDK), search engine (OpenSearch or equivalent), healthcare professional authentication, CRM, and third-party APIs.
Define coding, code review, and testing standards for the squad (Java, Spring, OSGi/Sling, and front-end); lead architecture reviews and critical pull request reviews.
Ensure security and compliance, including OWASP standards, secrets management, authoring permissions, and LGPD compliance across content and logs.
Produce and maintain architecture documentation (diagrams, architectural decisions, and runbooks) and present it during project phase approval gates.
Provide technical guidance to the squad's developers and collaborate with the client's Technology and Information Security teams.
Requirements
Must-have qualifications
8+ years of experience in software engineering, including at least 3 years in high-traffic web solution architecture.
Proven experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), including content models, components, Dispatcher, Cloud Manager, or equivalent deployment pipelines.
Strong Java skills, including Spring Boot, Jackson, and the common ecosystem of frameworks and libraries.
Strong understanding of programming paradigms, SOLID principles, design patterns, and architectural patterns.
Experience configuring DevSecOps pipelines (CI/CD, security analysis, and Infrastructure as Code).
Experience configuring CDNs and caching strategies, with knowledge of distributed systems.
Architecture documentation skills and the ability to communicate with the client's technical leadership.
Native Portuguese and advanced English proficiency.
Nice-to-have qualifications
Experience with OSGi, Apache Sling, Servlets, and Edge Delivery Services.
Adobe certifications (AEM Sites Architect or Developer).
Experience integrating AEM with AEP, Target, and Web SDK.
Experience with search engines (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch) and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) over approved content.
Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry, particularly with regulatory content approval workflows.

descriptionBodyPlain:
How you’ll make an impact:
Are you an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer with a passion for platform architecture and solution design? Do you thrive in environments where you can drive innovation and shape the future of infrastructure? Join our team and play a key role in designing, building, and optimizing cutting-edge solutions that enhance our platform’s scalability, reliability, and efficiency. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust infrastructure designs, perform PoCs, and ensure our DevOps practices are aligned with the latest industry trends.
What will you be doing?
- Collaborate with software architects and development teams to define infrastructure requirements and design comprehensive platform solutions.
- Lead the design, implementation, and optimization of CI/CD pipelines to streamline software development, testing, and deployment processes.
- Architect and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation, enabling scalable and reproducible infrastructure management.
- Conduct PoCs to evaluate new tools, technologies, and methodologies, assessing their potential impact on the platform and operations.
- Monitor and enhance the performance, reliability, and scalability of systems, ensuring high availability across production and development environments.
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across infrastructure, deployments, and applications, implementing robust solutions to improve system stability.
- Integrate security best practices into the architecture and deployment processes, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.
- Mentor team members on advanced DevOps practices and contribute to establishing a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Requirements:
-  Extensive experience as a DevOps Engineer with a focus on platform architecture and designing scalable infrastructure solutions.
-  Proficiency in building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or CircleCI, with an emphasis on automation and efficiency.
- Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar), with the ability to create scalable solutions and streamline operations.
-  Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), including production-grade deployments.
-  Deep knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, with expertise in infrastructure provisioning and management.
-  Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and experience with relevant tools (Terraform, CloudFormation).
-  Experience in performing PoCs and assessing new tools and technologies to enhance infrastructure and operations.
-  Security-focused mindset with a track record of implementing best practices for securing cloud-based and on-premise environments.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and collaborate effectively across teams.
You will stand out if you have:
- Relevant certifications such as Azure Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or other cloud and DevOps-related certifications.
- Previous experience in roles involving software development or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
- Proven experience with Azure, including designing and managing infrastructure, implementing DevOps practices, and leveraging Azure-specific services.
- A history of designing or contributing to platform-level architecture and infrastructure strategies.

descriptionBodyPlain:
Your Mission: Join our team in a pivotal role that combines solid technical quality assurance skills with strong business acumen. As a QA Analyst, you will work directly with the client's teams and alongside our QA Lead, helping to safeguard product quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. Your mission is to design and execute thorough test coverage, truly understand the business rules and overall functioning of the project, and bring AI-augmented practices into your day-to-day testing work.
Key Responsibilities:
- Design, produce, and execute test cases (manual and automated) across functional, regression, integration, and non-functional testing.
- Work directly with the client's teams to learn the business rules, user flows, and overall functioning of the project, translating that understanding into effective test coverage.
- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify test scenarios, edge cases, and potential risks early in the development cycle.
- Execute test cycles, log and track defects, and work closely with developers to validate fixes.
- Contribute to the QA strategy defined by the QA Lead, suggesting improvements to test coverage, processes, and tooling.
- Communicate test results, risks, and quality status clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
- Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to clarify requirements and ensure testability of new features.
- Organize and prioritize your own testing activities independently, managing competing deadlines with minimal supervision.
- Apply AI tools to improve test design, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall testing efficiency.
- Document test cases, test plans, and quality reports to ensure standardization and alignment with the client's compliance and performance standards.
Requirements for this Position:
- Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence and clarity to engage directly with the client's teams.
- Strong self-organization and autonomy, with a proven ability to manage priorities and deliver without close supervision.
- Solid technical background in QA, including test case design, execution, defect tracking, and test automation concepts.
- Hands-on experience in software testing, with a track record of owning test coverage for non-trivial features or modules.
- Business-oriented mindset, genuinely interested in learning the project's business rules and overall functioning, not just its technical layer.
- Current, practical experience using AI tools applied to QA (e.g., AI-assisted test case generation, AI-powered test automation, or AI-driven defect analysis).
- Experience with Agile methodologies and QA processes within Agile delivery.
- Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive mindset, comfortable raising risks and proposing improvements rather than just executing scripts.
Stand-out Requirements: You will be one step ahead if you have:
- Hands-on experience working in an agentic AI setting applied to QA, leveraging autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents to support test generation, execution, or analysis.
- Experience working directly with a client's teams, without an intermediary layer of stakeholders.
- Familiarity with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience working in digital consulting environments.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We're assembling a small team to take over a set of backend services that power a direct-to-consumer commerce platform of a global beverage/consumer goods company. The platform is being separated from the B2B ecosystem it was born in. As part of that separation, a group of critical services (orders, pricing, payments, and promotions/combos) is being forked as-is into the new environment, and they need a team that owns them.
 
The mission for this phase is clear: keep the lights on. Absorb these services fast, keep them stable through the highest-demand period of the year, and leave them better documented and tested than we found them. The client's architecture team is designing the target architecture in parallel. That work is not in this team's scope today, but it is the natural next step.
 
This is not greenfield. You'll inherit real services with real history, learn them from the people who built them.
 
What You'll Be Doing
Own a portfolio of forked backend services (mostly Java/Spring Boot): bug fixes, small changes, and day-to-day stability.
Drive knowledge transfer with the original team through shadowing sessions. Ask the right questions, map dependencies, and turn tacit knowledge into something written.
Build service context documentation in three layers (business rules, application behavior, operations) following the client's template. This feeds both the human team and the AI-assisted development model the client already runs in production.
Support incidents in a production environment that runs 24/7 across global markets, including critical flows like orders and payments.
Work within an Azure-based infrastructure (Azure DevOps, pipelines, and subscriptions), contributing to the duplication and adaptation of CI/CD pipelines for the new environment
Participate in the team's shift toward better engineering practices: adopting GitFlow, strengthening test coverage, and gradually incorporating quality gates — without breaking what already works
Help classify services by technical criticality and flag systemic risks early, such as hidden dependencies, shared databases/queues, and fragile integrations.
Requirements (Must Have):
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (coding agents, assistants) in real work, with judgment about when to trust and when to verify.
Java (backend, production experience) — this is non-negotiable
Spring Boot — the core framework across the service landscape
REST API design and integration
Azure DevOps — familiarity with pipelines, repos, and environments
Non relational (CosmosDB for MongoDB)  and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
Testing — JUnit for unit tests; familiarity with E2E or integration testing
Incident response mindset — ability to diagnose, triage, and resolve issues in complex distributed systems under pressure
English — for reading documentation, participating in cross-team calls, and written communication
Hands-on experience operating and debugging distributed microservices in production: logs, tracing, triage under pressure.
Clear, proactive communication. You'll extract knowledge from a team that is moving on, so you must be able to drive conversations, write things down, and escalate early.
Comfort working on inherited/legacy code with a "understand first, change carefully" mindset.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with microservices at scale — especially the operational realities of running and debugging many services in production
Azure cloud services beyond DevOps (Service Bus, Blob Storage, Functions, etc.)
Familiarity with DDD (Domain-Driven Design) concepts and service boundary thinking
Go — a secondary language used in some newer services
Understanding of internationalization and global commerce (multi-currency, multi-region systems)
Performance optimization experience in high-throughput environments
What Makes This Role Different:
You'll be joining at a moment that requires adaptability over idealism — the goal isn't to redesign what's working, it's to understand it deeply, keep it running, and incrementally move it toward a cleaner state. The team values engineers who can hold two things at once: operational discipline today and architectural vision for tomorrow.
If you've ever had to inherit complex legacy systems, win trust through reliability, and earn the space to improve things over time — this will feel familiar in the best way.
 
Seniority Levels:
We're open to Mid-Level and Senior profiles. Both levels are hands-on: everyone on this team writes code, fixes bugs, and takes on-call shifts. The difference is scope and autonomy.
Mid-Level: Delivers fixes and changes independently on well-understood services, with guidance on the more complex ones. Strong Java/Spring Boot fundamentals and solid microservices concepts. Takes part in incident response alongside senior engineers. Learns a complex domain fast through shadowing and documentation, and writes down what they learn.
Senior: Delivers the hardest changes and fixes, especially on critical flows such as orders, pricing and payments. Leads incident resolution end to end, from diagnosis to fix in production. Drives knowledge transfer sessions with the outgoing team and turns what comes out of them into documentation and service context. Spots systemic risks such as hidden dependencies, shared resources and fragile integrations. Sets the quality bar for the team through code reviews, tests and standards, mostly by example.

Drive knowledge transfer with the original team through shadowing sessions. Ask the right questions, map dependencies, and turn tacit knowledge into something written.
Build service context documentation in three layers (business rules, application behavior, operations) following the client's template. This feeds both the human team and the AI-assisted development model the client already runs in production.
Support incidents in a production environment that runs 24/7 across global markets, including critical flows like orders and payments.
Work within an Azure-based infrastructure (Azure DevOps, pipelines, and subscriptions), contributing to the duplication and adaptation of CI/CD pipelines for the new environment
Participate in the team's shift toward better engineering practices: adopting GitFlow, strengthening test coverage, and gradually incorporating quality gates — without breaking what already works
Help classify services by technical criticality and flag systemic risks early, such as hidden dependencies, shared databases/queues, and fragile integrations.
Requirements (Must Have):
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (coding agents, assistants) in real work, with judgment about when to trust and when to verify.
Java (backend, production experience) — this is non-negotiable
Spring Boot — the core framework across the service landscape
REST API design and integration
Azure DevOps — familiarity with pipelines, repos, and environments
Non relational (CosmosDB for MongoDB)  and relational databases (PostgreSQL)
Testing — JUnit for unit tests; familiarity with E2E or integration testing
Incident response mindset — ability to diagnose, triage, and resolve issues in complex distributed systems under pressure
English — for reading documentation, participating in cross-team calls, and written communication
Hands-on experience operating and debugging distributed microservices in production: logs, tracing, triage under pressure.
Clear, proactive communication. You'll extract knowledge from a team that is moving on, so you must be able to drive conversations, write things down, and escalate early.
Comfort working on inherited/legacy code with a "understand first, change carefully" mindset.
Nice to Have Skills:
Experience with microservices at scale — especially the operational realities of running and debugging many services in production
Azure cloud services beyond DevOps (Service Bus, Blob Storage, Functions, etc.)
Familiarity with DDD (Domain-Driven Design) concepts and service boundary thinking
Go — a secondary language used in some newer services
Understanding of internationalization and global commerce (multi-currency, multi-region systems)
Performance optimization experience in high-throughput environments
What Makes This Role Different:
You'll be joining at a moment that requires adaptability over idealism — the goal isn't to redesign what's working, it's to understand it deeply, keep it running, and incrementally move it toward a cleaner state. The team values engineers who can hold two things at once: operational discipline today and architectural vision for tomorrow.
If you've ever had to inherit complex legacy systems, win trust through reliability, and earn the space to improve things over time — this will feel familiar in the best way.
 
Seniority Levels:
We're open to Mid-Level and Senior profiles. Both levels are hands-on: everyone on this team writes code, fixes bugs, and takes on-call shifts. The difference is scope and autonomy.
Mid-Level: Delivers fixes and changes independently on well-understood services, with guidance on the more complex ones. Strong Java/Spring Boot fundamentals and solid microservices concepts. Takes part in incident response alongside senior engineers. Learns a complex domain fast through shadowing and documentation, and writes down what they learn.
Senior: Delivers the hardest changes and fixes, especially on critical flows such as orders, pricing and payments. Leads incident resolution end to end, from diagnosis to fix in production. Drives knowledge transfer sessions with the outgoing team and turns what comes out of them into documentation and service context. Spots systemic risks such as hidden dependencies, shared resources and fragile integrations. Sets the quality bar for the team through code reviews, tests and standards, mostly by example.

O profissional atuará como AI Deployer, desenhando e gerenciando fluxos de deployment em ambientes de engenharia AI-First, garantindo lançamentos seguros, confiáveis e rastreáveis.
Será responsável pela orquestração de pipelines, automação de gates de qualidade, provisionamento de ambientes, gestão de releases e implementação de estratégias de rollback em arquiteturas baseadas em containers, Kubernetes e serviços de nuvem.

- Provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura em Huawei Cloud e Azure.
- Administrar clusters Kubernetes em Huawei CCE e Azure AKS.
- Automatizar infraestrutura como código com Terraform.
- Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD utilizando Azure DevOps Pipelines e Huawei CodeArts.
- Definir e automatizar gates de qualidade, segurança e conformidade.
- Gerenciar releases e processos de deployment de aplicações.
- Implementar estratégias de rollback e recuperação de falhas.
- Automatizar provisionamento e configuração de ambientes.
- Configurar observabilidade, logging, monitoramento e alertas.
- Gerenciar identidade, acessos e políticas de segurança.
- Apoiar o provisionamento de bancos de dados e serviços de mensageria.
- Integrar processos de entrega assistidos por IA às esteiras de engenharia.
- Garantir rastreabilidade e estabilidade dos deployments.
- Identificar oportunidades de automação e otimização operacional.

- Experiência prática com Huawei Cloud.
- Conhecimento em Huawei CCE, ECS, OBS, FunctionGraph, LTS e IAM.

- Domínio de Terraform, Docker e Kubernetes.
- Experiência com Azure DevOps Pipelines.
- Conhecimento em Huawei CodeArts.
- Experiência na construção e sustentação de pipelines CI/CD.
- Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento de ambientes.
- Experiência com gerenciamento de releases, rollback e recuperação de falhas.
- Conhecimento em segurança de infraestrutura e automação de ambientes.

- Conhecimento em Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus e Huawei DMS.
- Experiência com SonarQube, Gitflow e práticas DevSecOps.
- Conhecimento em Agentic DevOps e AI-Assisted DevOps.
- Experiência com automação de quality gates para sistemas agênticos.
- Certificações Huawei Cloud, Azure ou Kubernetes.
- Conhecimento em estratégias Blue/Green e Canary Deployment.

* Desenvolver e automatizar testes funcionais.
* Automatizar testes de APIs.
* Implementar testes de contrato e integração.
* Estruturar testes ponta a ponta.
* Validar cenários de duplicidade, retry e reprocessamento.
* Testar comportamentos em situações de falha parcial.
* Validar consistência de dados entre SQL Server e Cosmos DB.
* Planejar e executar benchmarks.
* Executar testes de carga, stress e performance.
* Medir latência, throughput e comportamento da solução durante picos.
* Analisar consumo de RU/s e comportamento do Cosmos DB.
* Avaliar cenários de concorrência e resiliência.
* Criar evidências objetivas dos testes executados.
* Apoiar Arquitetura e Engenharia na definição dos critérios de aceite e performance.
######[Requisitos Obrigatórios]#######
* Experiência sólida com QA Automation.
* Experiência em automação de testes de APIs.
* Experiência com testes de integração e ponta a ponta.
* Experiência com testes de performance e carga.
* Conhecimento de ferramentas como k6, JMeter ou Azure Load Testing.
* Conhecimento de testes de aplicações e APIs .NET.
* Experiência com testes de concorrência e resiliência.
* Capacidade de analisar métricas de aplicações e infraestrutura.
* Experiência com validação e comparação de dados.
######[Desejável]#######
* Experiência com Microsoft Azure.
* Conhecimento de Azure Cosmos DB.
* Conhecimento de SQL Server.
* Experiência com Azure Monitor e Application Insights.
* Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e aplicações de alto volume.
* Conhecimento de testes de contrato.
* Experiência com cenários envolvendo retry, idempotência, processamento assíncrono e reprocessamento.

* Forte pensamento crítico.
* Rigor na validação e produção de evidências.

* Capacidade de identificar riscos antes da entrada em produção.

Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.
Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy. 
Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.
Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

descriptionBodyPlain:
Na CI&T, estamos abrindo uma posição inédita de AI Engineer na nossa operação dedicada à Porto.
É um papel sênior, equivalente a um Software Architect, para atuar em uma frente estratégica: a construção de uma plataforma de contexto do cliente. Ela vai consolidar, em tempo quase real, eventos e dados de múltiplos produtos e sistemas (seguros, banco, atendimento, CRM, analytics e data lake) para viabilizar experiências personalizadas, proativas e omnichannel. Também vai alimentar motores de recomendação (Next Best Action / Next Best Offer) e agentes de IA.
Você será a referência técnica em duas dimensões. A primeira é a arquitetura orientada a eventos da plataforma. A segunda são os métodos de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. Você vai definir padrões, ferramentas e processos que escalam para times de alta complexidade.
O que você vai fazer:
Ser responsável pela entrega técnica do squad, garantindo qualidade, previsibilidade e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais.
Desenhar e evoluir a arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) da plataforma: ingestão por push (eventos e filas) e por pull (integração com sistemas de origem), event store e linha do tempo do cliente, e exposição do contexto para canais e consumidores.
Definir padrões de integração e de sistemas distribuídos (pub/sub, event sourcing, CQRS, Outbox, Saga, idempotência, reprocessamento, DLQ), garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e resiliência.
Governar contratos de eventos (schemas, versionamento e compatibilidade) entre produtores e consumidores de diferentes domínios.
Propor padrões de integração entre agentes de IA e a plataforma de eventos, como agentes que consomem e enriquecem o contexto do cliente, exposição de contexto via MCP e ferramentas e acionamento de canais (app, SMS/WhatsApp).
Apoiar a arquitetura dos fluxos de recomendação e engajamento (NBA/NBO, ofertas personalizadas, alertas e campanhas), tanto reativos quanto preditivos.
Conduzir o refinamento técnico junto ao time de produto, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções viáveis e bem dimensionadas.
Apoiar a organização do backlog do squad, priorizando débito técnico, riscos arquiteturais e oportunidades de automação com IA.
Liderar a adoção e evolução de ferramentas agênticas de desenvolvimento (com Claude Code à frente) no squad.
Definir e disseminar métodos de desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit, BMAD) como base, adaptando o ciclo de vida ao contexto do produto.
Desenhar e implementar processos agênticos em todo o fluxo de engenharia: code review com IA, geração e manutenção de testes, refatoração assistida, documentação viva (ADRs, catálogo de eventos) e automação de PRs.
Mentorar engenheiros, elevando a maturidade do time em arquitetura orientada a eventos e em engenharia assistida por IA.

Indispensável:
Experiência sólida como arquiteto de software ou engenheiro sênior em sistemas distribuídos, com vivência prática em arquitetura orientada a eventos em produção.
Domínio de mensageria e streaming (Kafka/Amazon MSK, SNS/SQS, EventBridge ou equivalentes) e de padrões como event sourcing, CQRS, Outbox, Saga e consistência eventual.
Experiência com o ecossistema Java (Spring Boot) e com arquiteturas serverless e de microsserviços na AWS.
Experiência com integração de dados entre múltiplos sistemas de origem (APIs, eventos, CDC, data lake).
Experiência prática profunda com ferramentas agênticas de desenvolvimento, em particular o Claude Code.
Domínio de Spec-Driven Development (Spec-Kit e/ou BMAD) e capacidade de adaptar o ciclo a contextos reais de produto.
Visão sistêmica aguçada, capaz de enxergar arquitetura, dependências e impactos entre times e domínios.
Vivência em liderança técnica e histórico de responsabilidade direta pela entrega técnica de squads.
Experiência conduzindo refinamento técnico e organização de backlog em parceria com Product Owners.
Repertório consolidado em processos agênticos aplicados ao desenvolvimento (code review com IA, agentes para QA, automações de pipeline).
Conhecimento atualizado dos workflows agênticos emergentes e capacidade de adaptá-los à realidade da operação.
Disponibilidade:
É necessário ter disponibilidade para estar no cliente em SP alguns dias da semana.
Diferenciais:
Vivência com MCP (Model Context Protocol) e construção de agentes customizados, tanto para fluxos de engenharia quanto integrados a produtos.
Experiência com plataformas de Customer 360 / Customer Data Platform, personalização ou motores de NBA/NBO.
Experiência com contratos de eventos e Schema Registry (Avro, AsyncAPI).
Experiência com plataformas de dados (Databricks, data lake/lakehouse) e integração com CRM (Salesforce).
Domain-Driven Design (DDD) aplicado a contextos de eventos de domínio.
Infraestrutura como código (Terraform ou AWS CDK) e observabilidade de fluxos assíncronos (tracing distribuído, OpenTelemetry).
Experiência prévia em ecossistemas de seguros, pagamentos ou produtos financeiros regulados.
