text: [Job- 32405] Senior Back End Developer  (Python/Golang & SAP), Brazil
descriptionBodyPlain:
We are seeking a Senior AI Software Developer to design, build, and integrate business-critical enterprise applications within a Microsoft Azure environment. This role combines strong software engineering skills, AI-assisted development, cloud-native architecture, and hands-on experience integrating applications with SAP ERP and/or SAP S/4HANA.
The ideal candidate must be able to develop enterprise applications that securely exchange data with SAP, leveraging SAP integration interfaces, APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures. Experience with SAP integration is a core requirement, as the role involves connecting modern cloud applications and AI-powered solutions with SAP and other enterprise systems.
Required Skills:
Strong experience developing and supporting enterprise-grade software applications.
Strong development experience with Go (Golang) and Python.
Experience building and deploying cloud-native applications in Microsoft Azure.
Hands-on experience integrating enterprise applications with SAP ERP and/or SAP S/4HANA.
Practical knowledge of SAP integration methods and interfaces, such as APIs, OData, IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, middleware, messaging, or equivalent SAP integration patterns.
Ability to understand SAP data structures and business processes sufficiently to design reliable integrations between SAP and external applications.
Experience using AI-assisted software development tools, such as: 
OpenAI Codex
Claude Code
GitHub Copilot
Similar AI coding and software engineering tools.
Experience developing applications or technical solutions for consumer goods, manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, or related industries.
Strong understanding of SQL, relational databases, database schemas, and application-to-database integration.
Experience working with PostgreSQL or similar relational database technologies.
Understanding of application-specific databases, shared databases, data ownership, and database integration patterns.
Strong understanding of caching architecture, including: 
Distributed caching
Cache invalidation strategies
Cache-aside patterns
Application performance optimization
Technologies such as Redis or equivalent platforms.
Fluent or professional working proficiency in English is required for written documentation, technical discussions, collaboration, and stakeholder communication.
Azure & Integration Experience
Experience developing applications within an Azure architecture incorporating technologies such as:
Azure API Management (APIM)
Azure Service Bus
Azure Event Hubs
Azure Database for PostgreSQL
Application-specific and centralized database architectures
Microsoft Entra ID
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Azure Key Vault
Azure networking and secure application connectivity
Monitoring, logging, and application observability
CI/CD and automated cloud deployment
Experience integrating Azure-hosted applications with SAP is essential, including the ability to design secure, reliable, and maintainable data flows between SAP and cloud-based applications. Experience with SAP connectivity, API management, middleware, and asynchronous messaging is highly relevant.
AI Development & Integration
Experience incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise applications.
Experience integrating applications with LLMs or AI services.
Understanding of AI agents, tool/function calling, RAG, and enterprise data retrieval.
Ability to securely integrate AI applications with enterprise APIs, databases, SAP, and other internal systems.
Understanding of data privacy, security, access controls, and governance for enterprise AI solutions.
Experience using AI tools as part of the software development lifecycle, including code generation, refactoring, testing, troubleshooting, documentation, and code review.
Ability to design AI-powered solutions that interact securely with SAP data and business processes through appropriate APIs and integration layers.
Architecture & Engineering Knowledge
Strong understanding of REST APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience with microservices and distributed application architectures.
Understanding of asynchronous messaging and event-driven systems.
Knowledge of authentication and authorization concepts such as OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
Understanding of application resiliency, retry handling, fault tolerance, scalability, and high availability.
Ability to design maintainable application and database architectures.
Experience troubleshooting application, integration, database, and cloud-platform issues.
Ability to troubleshoot and resolve integration issues involving SAP, APIs, middleware, databases, and cloud applications.
Preferred Experience
Experience developing software for a consumer goods manufacturer.
Experience with SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite/CPI, SAP MDG, SAP Variant Configuration, or other SAP functional/technical domains.
Experience integrating SAP with manufacturing, order-management, MES, WMS, or shop-floor systems.
Experience with Redis or other distributed caching technologies.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containers, and cloud-native deployment practices.
Experience taking AI-enabled applications from prototype through production deployment.
Experience designing and implementing integrations using SAP-specific tools and platforms, such as SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite/CPI.

text: [Job- 32405] Senior Back End Developer (Python/Golang & SAP), Colombia
descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design, develop, and scale high-performance backend services, integrating AI capabilities into modern distributed systems. This role combines strong backend engineering expertise with hands-on experience in LLM integrations, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool calling, leveraging technologies such as Go, Python, and Microsoft Azure.
The ideal candidate will bring a solid understanding of microservices architecture, event-driven systems, distributed caching, and resilient service design to build reliable, scalable, and AI-enabled backend solutions.
Responsibilities:
Backend Architecture & Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Go and Python, applying microservices and event-driven architecture principles to support high-performance, distributed applications.
AI & LLM Integration: Integrate LLM capabilities into backend services, implementing RAG pipelines, tool calling, and AI orchestration patterns to enable intelligent, context-aware application workflows.
Cloud Infrastructure & Performance Optimization: Build and integrate cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure, implementing distributed caching strategies with Redis and optimizing service performance, scalability, and resource utilization.
Reliability & Distributed Systems Engineering: Design resilient backend architectures by implementing fault tolerance, retries, timeouts, and appropriate error-handling strategies, ensuring reliable communication and execution across distributed services and AI-powered workflows.
 
Requirements:
Languages: Go (Golang) and Python. 
SAP integration (required): S/4HANA and ERP via OData, IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, APIs and middleware. Preferred: BTP, CPI, MDG, Variant Configuration.
Azure integration: APIM, Service Bus, Event Hubs, PostgreSQL, SQL, Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, Key Vault, networking, IaC.
Caching (required): Redis, distributed caching, cache-aside, invalidation.
AI (lighter): LLM integration, tool calling, RAG, and AI coding tools (Codex, Claude Code, Copilot).
Architecture: microservices, event-driven systems, resiliency and retries.

Olá, aqui é a Tamara da CI&T!
 
Sou do time de Talent Attraction e procuro profissionais localizados no Brasil para a posição de Specialist Developer Golang (AWS), que atuarão em um projeto do ramo financeiro. 
 
Responsabilidades:
Construção de Microserviços: Desenvolver e implementar microserviços utilizando Go, garantindo a escalabilidade e a eficiência das aplicações.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our Data Science & Artificial Intelligence team, designing, architecting, and building advanced AI solutions for our clients and internal teams.
We are looking for someone with strong hands-on experience building and deploying AI solutions in production environments, with the ability to make architectural decisions, define technical standards, and lead complex initiatives throughout the entire solution lifecycle.
About the Role
As an AI Engineer, you will play a senior technical role, working from architecture and solution design through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement in production.
You will tackle complex challenges across Generative AI, intelligent agents, RAG, enterprise integrations, LLMOps, observability, and reliability, ensuring that AI solutions are scalable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.
What You'll Do
Design AI solution architectures, considering performance, scalability, security, technical governance, operational costs, and long-term sustainability.
Build AI-powered products and platforms, ensuring strong engineering quality and alignment with business objectives.
Design and develop intelligent agents and multi-agent systems, including planning, reasoning, task orchestration, tool usage, and integration with multiple data sources.
Build advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, leveraging embeddings, vector databases, GraphRAG, hybrid search, reranking, and grounding techniques.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise ecosystems, including ERPs, CRMs, transactional systems, data platforms, and business-critical applications.
Evaluate and experiment with LLMs, Small Language Models (SLMs), multimodal models, and other components of the AI technology stack.
Define metrics and AI evaluation strategies to ensure solution quality, accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
Implement observability and monitoring for AI applications, tracking performance, quality, cost, usage, latency, security, and model behavior.
Establish LLMOps practices, including development, testing, versioning, deployment, and monitoring pipelines.
Act as a technical reference, influencing architectural decisions, promoting engineering best practices, and contributing to the technical evolution of the AI practice.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively in a global environment.
Strong experience developing and deploying Generative AI solutions in production environments.
Experience designing technical architectures for complex, business-critical enterprise solutions.
Experience technically leading complex, multidisciplinary initiatives.
Advanced proficiency in Python.
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, or equivalent frameworks.
Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar AI platforms.
Advanced knowledge of RAG architectures, embeddings, and semantic search.
Experience with vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus, or equivalent technologies.
Experience developing APIs and microservices.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Knowledge of observability, monitoring, and reliability engineering practices.
Nice to Have
Experience building AI platforms used across multiple clients, products, or business units.
Experience implementing multi-agent architectures in production.
Knowledge of Fine-Tuning, PEFT, LoRA, and other model customization techniques.
Experience with Knowledge Graphs and GraphRAG.
Experience with automated LLM evaluation and AI Evaluation frameworks.
Advanced knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps.
Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks or Snowflake.
Contributions to technical communities, open-source projects, or AI-related publications.
Advanced certifications in AI, cloud architecture, or software engineering.
The Challenge
This role goes beyond AI experimentation and proof-of-concept development. We are looking for someone who can turn emerging AI capabilities into reliable, scalable, production-ready solutions, making sound technical decisions while keeping business impact at the center of the work.

descriptionBodyPlain:
About Us:
At CI&T, our rapid growth is fueled by the innovative solutions we create for our global clients. We are seeking a Master DataOps Engineer to own the operational backbone — environments, CI/CD, and monitoring — for a large-scale Finance data platform modernization at a major US mortgage lender, so the platform being built is reliable and cost-governed from day one, not bolted on at the end. 
Responsibilities:
Environment Provisioning & Platform Readiness
Own end-to-end environment provisioning and platform readiness across the full data stack — from SQL Server CDC source through Snowflake landing, raw, and curated layers — ahead of and during the build, with a formal readiness checklist delivered before sensitive-data build begins.
Provision and maintain Snowflake environments (DEV → QA → UAT → Prod) with dedicated, right-sized warehouses per workload class — replication/ingestion, curated-layer transformation, and BI serving — each with auto-suspend, resource monitors, and cost attribution from day one.
Coordinate Azure infrastructure provisioning: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault, self-hosted Azure DevOps agents, and VM infrastructure for the CDC replication tool — including firewall rules, TLS certificate requests, and DNS resolution for private Snowflake endpoints, all with documented lead times surfaced proactively.
Manage Snowflake RBAC provisioning: dedicated project-specific role hierarchy, clearly separated from broad IT, developer, analyst, and AI roles; positive and negative access tests executed before the environment is handed over to the build team.
Manage the full vendor and service account access lifecycle: named, individual, time-bound, least-privilege access for all delivery personnel; dedicated non-personal service accounts for replication, Snowflake, and BI integrations; credential storage and rotation via Azure Key Vault; revocation with documented evidence at engagement end.
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering
Build and operate the CI/CD pipeline for all data artifacts — transformation logic, metric definitions, replication configurations, Snowflake object DDL, and versioned SQL transformation models — using Azure DevOps Pipelines with YAML-based, version-controlled pipeline definitions.
Enforce a DEV → QA → UAT → Prod promotion path with branch policies, required reviewers, build validation on PRs, and written approval gates before any production deployment — no silent or automatic production changes.
Integrate automated regression, schema validation, row-count checks, and data quality assertions at every promotion stage — not only before go-live.
Externalize all environment-specific configuration from code; integrate Azure DevOps Variable Groups linked to Azure Key Vault so no credentials are stored as plaintext in pipeline definitions or repository files.
Integrate code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning (e.g., Checkov, Microsoft Defender for DevOps) into CI pipelines; remediate or formally document exceptions for all material findings before promotion to production.
Design, document, and rehearse rollback procedures for every promotion stage, including a full mock cutover and rollback rehearsal before the production readiness gate.
Monitoring, Alerting & Observability
Implement and own end-to-end pipeline monitoring using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics: replication health, CDC lag alerts, replication agent availability, Snowflake warehouse freshness against agreed SLA targets, schema-change and drift detection events at the landing zone, and semantic-definition change alerts.
Configure Azure Monitor Alert Rules routed via Action Groups to the client's approved ITSM tool (e.g., ServiceNow), with named alert owners, defined thresholds, and documented escalation paths — every alert fully operable by the client's DataOps team without vendor involvement post-handoff.
Enable and maintain Diagnostic Settings on all Azure resources (Key Vault, VMs, NSGs, Storage Accounts) feeding a centralized Log Analytics Workspace with appropriate retention, access control, and audit trails covering authentication, access grants, configuration changes, and deployments.
Implement Snowflake resource monitors and Azure Cost Management budget alerts for cost anomaly detection; produce periodic FinOps attribution reports by workload class.
Platform Cost Governance & FinOps
Own platform cost attribution and consumption monitoring across all Snowflake warehouses and Azure compute resources, with per-workload attribution established from day one using a consistent resource tagging strategy enforced via IaC.
Deliver a Snowflake and Azure cost model at architecture gate, including monitored budgets, right-sizing recommendations, and auto-suspend configurations — not estimated retrospectively.
Conduct periodic right-sizing reviews using Azure Advisor and Snowflake usage data; present findings in structured FinOps reviews with the client's Cloud Architecture team.
Infrastructure as Code
Manage all Azure infrastructure as code using Terraform (or Bicep where appropriate), including VNets, NSGs, Key Vault, VMs, storage accounts, Entra ID service principals, and RBAC role assignments — no manual portal configurations for anything that belongs in the production baseline.
Manage Snowflake object provisioning (databases, schemas, warehouses, roles, resource monitors) via the Snowflake Terraform provider, maintaining remote state in Azure Blob Storage with state locking.
Enforce configuration standards via Azure Policy guardrails (e.g., soft-delete on Key Vault, no public IPs on data resources, mandatory resource tagging) so IaC deployments are validated against policy before they reach production.
Architecture & Operational Documentation
Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and other living delivery artifacts alongside the Lead Architect — including network and connectivity design, environment topology, CI/CD promotion model, and security access design — in client-controlled repositories from the first commit.
Write and validate operational runbooks covering: replication failure, recovery, and resynchronization; CDC lag breach response; deployment and rollback procedures; reconciliation-discrepancy triage; access request and revocation workflows; cost-anomaly response; and incident routing via client ITSM — each exercised with the client's DataOps team before final handoff acceptance.
Knowledge Transfer & Client Engagement
Drive progressive knowledge transfer from the architecture phase onward through paired working sessions, shadowed deployments, and runbook exercises — not a single end-of-project handoff.
Act as the named point of contact for platform operations across the delivery team and the client's DataOps, Cloud Architecture, Infrastructure/Network, and Information Security teams — translating technical platform concerns into clear client-facing communications in fluent English.
Quantify and track client infrastructure dependencies — Snowflake environments, Azure network paths, service accounts, replication tool licensing, and production change windows — with named need-by dates and schedule-impact statements, escalating proactively when readiness is at risk.
 

 
Requirements:
Solid, hands-on experience in DataOps or platform engineering roles supporting a production cloud data platform end-to-end — covering provisioning, CI/CD, monitoring, and operational handoff.
Strong CI/CD experience for data pipelines: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), Git-based workflows with branch policies and approval gates, automated testing and regression gates, and multi-environment promotion paths.
Azure infrastructure fluency: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Link and Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault (secrets, certificates, and rotation), Microsoft Entra ID (service principals, managed identities, PIM, and access reviews), Azure Monitor and Log Analytics, and Azure Cost Management.
Infrastructure as Code: hands-on Terraform experience including remote state management on Azure Blob Storage, the Snowflake Terraform provider, and IaC security scanning integrated into CI pipelines.
Snowflake platform experience: RBAC design, warehouse sizing and segregation, resource monitors, row-access policies, and dynamic data masking — experience across Enterprise or Business Critical editions preferred.
CDC replication pipeline monitoring and operations: experience monitoring and alerting on a CDC-based replication pipeline in production, including lag monitoring, restart and recovery procedures, and schema-drift detection at the landing layer.
Secrets management discipline: experience managing pipeline credentials via Azure Key Vault with no plaintext credentials in repositories or pipeline definitions, and documented rotation procedures.
Security-aware development practices: experience integrating code scanning, dependency scanning, and IaC scanning into CI pipelines; familiarity with least-privilege access design and audit logging requirements in regulated or sensitive-data environments.
Platform cost governance as a named responsibility: experience owning FinOps attribution, budget alerts, and right-sizing reviews — not as a shared or ambient concern.
Fluent English (B2+): this role is the named client-facing point of contact for all platform operations topics across delivery and client teams.
 

 
Nice to Have

Own end-to-end environment provisioning and platform readiness across the full data stack — from SQL Server CDC source through Snowflake landing, raw, and curated layers — ahead of and during the build, with a formal readiness checklist delivered before sensitive-data build begins.
Provision and maintain Snowflake environments (DEV → QA → UAT → Prod) with dedicated, right-sized warehouses per workload class — replication/ingestion, curated-layer transformation, and BI serving — each with auto-suspend, resource monitors, and cost attribution from day one.
Coordinate Azure infrastructure provisioning: Virtual Networks, NSGs, Private Endpoints, Azure Key Vault, self-hosted Azure DevOps agents, and VM infrastructure for the CDC replication tool — including firewall rules, TLS certificate requests, and DNS resolution for private Snowflake endpoints, all with documented lead times surfaced proactively.

Build and operate the CI/CD pipeline for all data artifacts — transformation logic, metric definitions, replication configurations, Snowflake object DDL, and versioned SQL transformation models — using Azure DevOps Pipelines with YAML-based, version-controlled pipeline definitions.

Your responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Apache Spark, SQL, and Python or Scala.
Build solutions to process and transform large datasets efficiently.
Monitor and optimize existing data pipelines and workflows, improving performance, scalability, throughput, and reliability.
Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
Implement data quality checks and governance practices to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and compliance.
Troubleshoot complex data and pipeline issues, identifying root causes and proposing sustainable solutions.
Maintain clear technical documentation and contribute to engineering standards and best practices across the team.
What we are looking for
Solid professional experience in Data Engineering, particularly designing and developing data pipelines.
Hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark.
Strong knowledge of SQL and experience working with large datasets.
Proficiency in Python or Scala for data engineering.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based data solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to troubleshoot complex data issues.
Excellent communication skills in English and Portuguese, with confidence working in collaborative environments and interacting with clients and stakeholders.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for an Adoption Lead to drive user adoption, engagement, and change management for a portfolio of enterprise digital products used by a global client across multiple regions, segments, and personas. You will own the adoption and change strategy end to end: define what success looks like, measure it, and work with Product, Design, and Engineering to turn insights into prioritized actions that make the products something users want to use. You'll work in a SAFe/Agile environment alongside the GPM, Product Owners, Digital Strategist, Lead Designer, RTE, and business stakeholders.
What you'll do
- Define and execute the adoption and change management strategy for the product portfolio.
- Build the product desirability strategy (basic needs, performance needs, and delighters) together with the GPM, PO, Digital Strategist, and Lead Designer.
- Define and run the AARRR (Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue) framework with the GPM and Digital Strategist.
- Set up KPI tracking for usage, adherence, adoption, and simplification with the Engineering team, then monitor these indicators with analytics tools such as Piano, Power BI, and Microsoft Clarity.
- Produce regular adoption reports and present insights and recommendations to product and business stakeholders.
- Map and prioritize features by persona, region, segment, and offering, and coordinate with PMs, Designers, and Tech Leads to prioritize actions and features based on the desirability strategy.
- Work with the Lead Designer and GPM/PO to identify and reduce friction across user journeys.
- Plan and execute communication and training for product rollouts, including a communication calendar, reusable templates, and targeted adoption campaigns.
- Engage directly with end users to collect feedback, understand their needs, and build advocacy for the products.
What we're looking for
- Fluent French (required), plus fluent English for day-to-day work with global stakeholders.
- Proven experience in product adoption, change management, digital transformation, or customer success for digital products in a corporate environment.
- Hands-on experience defining and tracking product KPIs, and turning data into clear, actionable reports for different audiences.
- Familiarity with product analytics tools (Piano, Power BI, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics, or similar).
- Knowledge of product growth frameworks such as AARRR and the Kano model (basic needs, performance needs, delighters).
- Experience planning communication and training campaigns for large, distributed user bases.
- Comfortable working in Agile/SAFe environments with multiple product and business stakeholders.
- Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence prioritization without direct authority.
Nice to have
- Background in UX research, service design, or digital marketing.
- Experience working with multinational clients across different regions and cultures.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for a Senior Data Developer with strong knowledge in developing and maintaining data pipelines in Databricks, Medallion Architecture, integrating and transforming data from various sources, such as APIs, relational databases, files, and many others!
As a senior member of the team, you will also provide technical guidance, mentor peers, and collaborate with cross-functional teams including data scientists, analysts, and platform engineers.
As a Senior Data Developer, you will lead the design and development of robust data pipelines, integrating and transforming data from diverse data sources such as APIs, relational databases, and files. Collaborating closely with business and analytics teams, you will ensure high-quality deliverables that meet the strategic needs of our organization.
Your expertise will be pivotal in maintaining the quality, reliability, security and governance of the ingested data, therefore driving our mission of Collaboration, Innovation, & Transformation.
 
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain data pipelines.
Integrate data from various sources (APIs, relational databases, files, etc.).
Collaborate with business and analytics teams to understand data requirements.
Ensure quality, reliability, security and governance of the ingested data.
Follow modern DataOps practices such as Code Versioning, Data Tests and CI/CD.
Document processes and best practices in data engineering.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Must-have Skills
Proven experience in building and managing large-scale data pipelines in Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake, SQL).
Strong programming skills in Python and SQL for data processing and transformation.
Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data warehousing, and distributed data processing.
Hands-on experience with modern DataOps practices: version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and related data services.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot performance, scalability, and reliability issues.
Proficiency in Git.
Advanced English is essential.
Nice-to-have Skills
Experience with data contracts, schema evolution, and ensuring compatibility across services.
Expertise in data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Soda, dbt tests, or custom-built solutions).
Integration with Power BI.

descriptionBodyPlain:
About the Role
We are looking for a senior, hands-on Data Tech Lead to drive the technical leadership of our data engineering initiatives on Databricks in Azure.
You will partner directly with the Data Architect to define standards and references, remove roadblocks, and enable the Data Engineering team to deliver scalable, reliable pipelines aligned with the business within the Medallion architecture.
 
Key Responsibilities
Provide technical leadership to Data Engineering squads, supporting design, reviews, and decision-making to unblock delivery.
Co-define with the Data Architect the technical vision, coding standards, modeling conventions, and best practices for the Lakehouse (Delta Lake + Medallion).
Design and oversee pipelines in Databricks (PySpark/Spark SQL) across Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, ensuring security, performance, and governance.
Implement and reinforce DataOps practices: version control (Git), CI/CD, testing (unit/integration/data quality), and documentation.
Optimize jobs/pipelines: partitioning, Spark tuning, cost management, and reliability (baseline observability and alerting).
Ensure non-functional requirements: security, access control, and data policies in Azure/Databricks aligned with defined governance.
Collaborate with stakeholders (business/analytics) to translate requirements into scalable solutions with realistic delivery plans.
Mentor engineers, promote standards, and create references (templates, playbooks) to accelerate the team.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Must-have Skills
Strong experience in Data Engineering and projects, with experience as a Tech Lead/Senior leading teams technically and operationally.
Strong hands-on experience in Databricks: PySpark and Spark SQL; batch pipelines (and working knowledge of streaming when needed).
Mastery of Delta Lake and practical application of the Medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold).
Solid experience with Azure for data, including at least: Azure Databricks, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), and integration with security/identity services (e.g., Azure Active Directory).
Strong SQL and Python skills; fundamentals in modeling (dimensional/consumption) and good practices for contracts/schemas.
Experience with DataOps: Git, CI/CD for data pipelines, automated testing, and clear documentation.
Proven ability to review design/code, resolve performance/scale issues, and guide teams.
Advanced English to work with stakeholders and produce technical documentation.
 
Nice-to-have Skills
Unity Catalog (governance/lineage/access control) and Databricks Workflows/Repos; Delta Live Tables.
Data quality frameworks (Great Expectations/Soda) and/or dbt on the Lakehouse.
Orchestration (Airflow/Databricks Workflows) and observability (metrics, logs, alerts).
Experience with CDC/streaming ingestion (Event Hubs/Kafka) when applicable.
Consulting experience and international client exposure; Databricks/Azure certifications.

text: [Job-32286]  Vice President, Strategic OEM Accounts, Hybrid in Reston, VA / DMV area
descriptionBodyPlain:
This exciting hybrid role, based in Washington, D.C., and/or Reston, Virginia, requires you to be available to go to one of our vibrant offices approximately three times a week. The remainder of your work can be completed remotely. Join us in fostering innovation and teamwork in a dynamic environment!
Overview
The Vice President, Strategic OEM Accounts – Americas is an executive leadership position responsible for the strategic direction, commercial growth, and overall health of CI&T's relationship with a major global automotive OEM group across the United States, Canada, and Brazil.
The role encompasses multiple automotive brands and financial services entities within the group, while actively pursuing opportunities across additional brands and business units as the relationship evolves.
Acting as the executive sponsor, this individual will be accountable for strengthening strategic partnerships, driving sustainable revenue growth and profitability, and positioning CI&T as a trusted partner in business, product, technology, and AI-enabled transformation.
This role combines strategic client leadership, commercial accountability, and multidisciplinary team management, requiring an executive who can navigate complex automotive organizations, shape high-value opportunities, and translate emerging technologies into measurable business outcomes.
Responsibilities
Strategic Client Leadership (Automotive Accounts)
Serve as the executive sponsor for CI&T's strategic automotive OEM client relationships across the United States, Canada, and Brazil, spanning multiple automotive brands, financial services entities, and other relevant business units within the group.
Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client executives and decision-makers across digital, business, technology, and commercial functions.
Define and execute a unified account strategy that balances individual brand priorities with opportunities for collaboration, scale, and expansion across the broader OEM group.
Position CI&T as a long-term strategic partner, proactively identifying client challenges, shaping transformation agendas, and driving measurable business value.
Establish strong executive governance, account planning, and stakeholder engagement practices to ensure client satisfaction, relationship continuity, and long-term partnership health.
Commercial Growth & Sales Strategy
Own the commercial performance of the strategic automotive account portfolio across the Americas, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, pipeline development, and long-term account sustainability.
Develop and execute strategic growth plans across existing engagements, new business opportunities, additional brands, and adjacent business functions.
Lead complex commercial pursuits, including opportunity qualification, solution shaping, proposals, pricing strategies, contract negotiations, and executive-level deal closure.
Partner with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and regional leadership to establish commercial forecasts, optimize account economics, and maintain a healthy balance between growth and profitability.
Identify opportunities to introduce innovative commercial models, including outcome-based engagements, and AI-enabled delivery models.
Leverage strategic technology partnerships and CI&T's global capabilities to unlock new opportunities and differentiate CI&T in competitive pursuits.
Product, Technology & AI Leadership
Provide strategic leadership across digital products, customer experiences, enterprise platforms, data, and AI-enabled transformation within the automotive ecosystem.
Bring a strong point of view on the future of automotive, including connected customer experiences, digital retail, dealer enablement, financial services, and emerging AI applications.
Translate evolving client business priorities into actionable product, technology, and transformation strategies that deliver measurable outcomes.
Champion AI-native ways of working, including AI-enabled software development, intelligent automation, and agentic solutions, to improve delivery efficiency, quality, and client value.
Collaborate with CI&T's global Technology, Product, Design, Data, AI, and Offerings teams to bring differentiated capabilities and reusable solutions into the strategic automotive account portfolio.
Ensure that strategic recommendations and technology investments are aligned with client business objectives, commercial priorities, and long-term digital transformation roadmaps.
Team & Individual Management
Provide executive leadership to multidisciplinary account teams operating across the United States, Canada, and Brazil, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and commercially accountable culture.
Lead, coach, and develop senior account and functional leaders, establishing clear expectations, performance objectives, and professional development pathways.
Partner with Delivery and functional leadership to ensure appropriate organizational structures, resource allocation, and capabilities are in place to support account commitments and future growth.
Build effective succession plans and leadership pipelines to strengthen account continuity, reduce key-person dependencies, and enable sustainable scale.
Promote cross-market collaboration, knowledge sharing, and consistent leadership practices while respecting local market requirements and client relationships.
Act as a key interface between the account portfolio and CI&T's regional and global leadership, ensuring alignment with broader organizational priorities.
Marketing, Thought Leadership & Industry Engagement
Represent CI&T as a senior automotive industry leader through participation in conferences, webinars, executive roundtables, client events, and other relevant industry forums.
Partner with Marketing and Sales to shape automotive-focused thought leadership, campaigns, and content that strengthen CI&T's positioning in the market.
Contribute perspectives on emerging automotive trends, digital transformation, customer experience, and AI adoption, drawing on practical experience across the strategic automotive account portfolio.
Support strategic relationship-building initiatives with technology partners, industry organizations, and prospective clients to expand CI&T's visibility and commercial reach.
Collaborate with CI&T's regional and global leadership to develop compelling client success stories, market insights, and executive-level narratives that support business development.
Required Skills & Experience
Significant senior leadership experience within a digital consultancy, technology services organization, digital agency, or product-led services business.
Proven track record of leading and growing complex, multi-market enterprise accounts, ideally within the automotive OEM ecosystem.
Strong understanding of the automotive industry, including OEM business models, dealer networks, customer experience, digital commerce, connected services, and financial services.
Demonstrated success in commercial growth, account profitability, executive stakeholder management, and complex enterprise deal negotiation.
Deep understanding of digital product development, modern technology platforms, data, cloud, and AI-enabled solutions, with the ability to connect technological innovation to business outcomes.
Experience leading multidisciplinary, geographically distributed teams within a global, matrixed organization.
Strong strategic and commercial judgment, with the ability to balance long-term relationship development, near-term revenue objectives, and operational performance.
Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across business and technology functions.
Experience working across North American (must) and Latin American (preferable) markets, with an appreciation for regional business dynamics and cultural differences.
Fluent English required; Portuguese and/or Spanish considered advantageous.

A CI&T busca uma pessoa AI Developer Sênior com foco no desenvolvimento e orquestração de agentes de IA Generativa para canais de voz e chat, operando em infraestrutura GPU na Oracle Cloud (OCI). O desafio central é implementar fluxos conversacionais de baixa latência e alta precisão, integrando-se a sistemas legados através do protocolo MCP e garantindo observabilidade completa via Langfuse.
Você trabalhará em colaboração direta com SREs para garantir deploy em OKE e com cientistas de dados para refinar a qualidade das respostas dos LLMs.
Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver orquestradores de atendimento em Python para canais de voz e chat.
Configurar camadas de segurança com NeMo Guardrails.
Integrar ferramentas corporativas (CRM, Billing) via MCP Servers.
Garantir instrumentação de traces para monitoramento de custos e performance via Langfuse.
Implementar fluxos conversacionais de baixa latência e alta precisão.
Colaborar com SREs no deploy em OKE e com cientistas de dados no refinamento da qualidade das respostas dos LLMs.
Requisitos para este desafio:
Desenvolvimento avançado em Python.
Experiência com orquestração de LLMs (LangChain e/ou LlamaIndex).
Conhecimento em Langfuse para observabilidade de agentes de IA.
Habilidade em engenharia de prompt.
Experiência com integração via APIs (REST/mTLS).
[Opcional] Diferenciais:
Conhecimento em NeMo Guardrails.
Familiaridade com Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Experiência com OCI Generative AI SDK.
Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes (OKE).
Familiaridade com Redis para gestão de contexto.

descriptionBodyPlain:
Senior Business Analyst — Digital Marketing
We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst with a strong digital marketing background to work with one of our global clients in the agribusiness sector — an international client that will enable working within a multicultural team with countries such as the US, Switzerland, India, and Brazil. If you have experience in software development, are fluent in the language of marketing, speak English with ease, and have found your calling in connecting business strategy to engineering execution, this position is made for you.
Your Mission
You’ll be embedded in the North American Seeds Routes to Market (RTM) digital ecosystem — a network of marketing portals, CMS-powered websites, CRM platforms, and analytics solutions that connect the brand with distributors, farmers, and partners across North America.
Your job goes beyond translating business vision into technical requirements: you’ll bring your own marketing perspective to the table, challenge assumptions with data, propose ideas around acquisition, activation, and retention, and define success through clear objectives and OKRs. The best outcome here is a client who feels they gained a strategic partner — not just someone who takes notes.
Day-to-day, you’ll work across Google Analytics 4, Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Salesforce CRM (SFDC), and web CMS platforms.
Must Have
6+ years in IT business analysis, with strong hands-on experience in digital marketing environments
Solid digital marketing background: you understand funnels (acquisition, activation, retention), know how to read and act on marketing metrics, and are comfortable proposing ideas — not just documenting them
Experience defining objectives and tracking results through OKRs or similar goal-setting frameworks in digital marketing contexts
Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 and at least one of the following: SFMC, SFDC, web CMS
Background in software development — you understand what it takes to turn requirements into code, and you use that to write better specs
Solid agile skills: backlog grooming, sprint planning, standups, retrospectives
Ability to produce clear, actionable documentation: user stories, data mapping, process flows, business rules
Fluent English — written and spoken. All stakeholder interactions are in English, daily
High soft skills: this role involves navigating senior, opinionated stakeholders. You know how to absorb, structure, and return with concrete proposals — not conflict
Nice to Have
Technical knowledge in Drupal, cloud platforms, Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), or ETF integrations
Experience with North American digital marketing strategies or route-to-market setups
Background in agribusiness, CPG, or agriculture technology
Familiarity with cross-functional integration testing and QA processes
Experience using analytics data to inform product decisions
Exposure to CI/CD environments
If you like it, just apply and good luck!

descriptionBodyPlain:
Senior Business Analyst
We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to work with one of our largest global clients in the agribusiness sector — an international client that will enable working within a multicultural team with countries such as the US, Switzerland, India, and Brazil. This is a senior-level, high-ownership role for someone who’s moved past just gathering requirements and is ready to shape product direction.

Your Mission
You’ll join one of the most established squads within CI&T’s partnership with this client — a mature engagement where the expectation is that you walk in and add value quickly, not wait to be told what to do.
Your scope covers the full requirements lifecycle: from leading discovery sessions with senior client stakeholders to validating that what gets shipped actually matches what was agreed. You’ll act as the connective tissue between business and engineering — managing priorities, leading agile ceremonies, and stepping into a de-facto PO role when the moment calls for it. The client relationship is solid, the team is experienced, and the bar for quality is high.
All interactions with the client’s product and business stakeholders are conducted in English.

Must Have
6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or equivalent strategic role in digital products
Demonstrated ability to act autonomously as a PO: backlog ownership, sprint planning, grooming, and retrospectives
Strong stakeholder management — you know how to navigate, align, and negotiate with senior business and technical stakeholders
Ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical requirements: use cases, workflows, acceptance criteria, data mapping
Solid technical literacy: you understand system architecture and API integrations well enough to lead feasibility conversations with engineering leads
Quality-first mindset: you validate deliveries against requirements and surface gaps before they reach QA
Fluent English — written and spoken. Daily client interactions happen in English
Nice to Have
Experience mentoring junior or mid-level analysts
Background working in large, global enterprise accounts with multi-team coordination
Experience shaping product roadmaps alongside Product Management leadership
Data-driven approach to product decisions: defining KPIs, analyzing business metrics, and using data to influence priorities
Familiarity with agile tools such as JIRA, Confluence, or Miro
If you like it, just apply and good luck!

descriptionBodyPlain:
CI&T está fortalecendo a infraestrutura de dados digitais de um cliente de destaque nos setores de Serviços Financeiros e Seguros, como parte de uma iniciativa estratégica de redesenho dos canais digitais do cliente — incluindo aplicativo, web e plataformas de atendimento direto ao cliente. A posição integrará squads que atuam com práticas orientadas a inteligência artificial desde a concepção dos produtos, reforçando a camada de dados que sustenta essas iniciativas.
A pessoa profissional será responsável pela construção e manutenção de pipelines e infraestrutura de dados com foco em ambientes de analytics digital, atuando em estreita colaboração com especialistas de Martech para garantir robustez na ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados para consumo analítico. O papel tem caráter predominantemente técnico e operacional, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados.
Responsabilidades:
Gerencia dados da plataforma, assegurando integridade, disponibilidade e consistência ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos dados.
Gerencia a tecnologia da plataforma, mantendo a infraestrutura de dados atualizada, estável e alinhada às necessidades do negócio.
Orquestra processos de extração, transformação e carga (ETL), automatizando fluxos de dados entre sistemas de origem e ambientes analíticos.
Arquiteta soluções de dados orientadas a eventos, definindo estruturas que suportam captura e processamento de dados em tempo real.
Cataloga dados para consumo, documentando fontes, definições e regras de negócio para facilitar o uso por equipes analíticas.
Promove a qualidade dos dados por meio da implementação de validações, testes e rotinas de monitoramento contínuo.
Promove a observabilidade da solução, implementando métricas e alertas que permitem identificar falhas e gargalos nos pipelines.
Promove a otimização de custos da infraestrutura de dados, revisando consumo de recursos e ajustando arquiteturas conforme necessário.
Habilita e integra dados de domínio, conectando fontes distintas para consolidar uma visão analítica unificada.
Gerencia APIs da solução, garantindo integrações seguras e performáticas entre sistemas.
Evolui a capacidade do stack de dados, avaliando e implementando melhorias tecnológicas de forma incremental.
Requisitos para este desafio:
Experiência sólida em programação back-end para construção de pipelines de dados, com proficiência em Python e/ou Node.js.
Domínio de SQL para manipulação, modelagem e otimização de dados em larga escala.
Experiência em arquitetura de soluções de banco de dados NoSQL e data warehouse na nuvem (ex.: BigQuery, Firestore).
Conhecimento sólido em conceitos de computação em nuvem (AWS e/ou Azure), com domínio das soluções de Big Data do Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Experiência na orquestração de pipelines de dados e processos de ETL (ex.: dbt, Airflow, Dataform).
Familiaridade com frameworks de governança e gestão de dados (ex.: DAMA, CRISP).
Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) em times multidisciplinares.
Diferenciais:
Certificações em nuvem (GCP, AWS ou Azure).
Experiência em ambientes ágeis de produtos digitais (aplicativo, web, atendimento ao cliente).
Vivência prévia no setor de Serviços Financeiros ou Seguros.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for a Data Architect with strong AWS expertise to drive the strategy, development, and execution of our enterprise data platforms and analytics products. In this role, you will bridge the gap between business stakeholders, data engineers, and data science teams to transform raw data assets into scalable, high-value data products. You will leverage cloud-native AWS services to manage the product lifecycle from discovery to rollout, ensuring high data quality, governance, and business impact.
Responsibilities:
Target architecture: Defines the target data architecture on AWS for the migration from Databricks, by documenting design decisions, patterns and trade-offs.
Migration planning: Plans the migration by assessing existing data assets, dependencies and risks, and sequencing the work in manageable stages.
Lakehouse and storage design: Designs table, Delta Lake and storage layouts for the new environment, including the refactoring of storage paths.
Technical leadership: Guides three data developers by setting engineering standards, reviewing solutions and removing technical blockers.
Validation: Defines how migrated data is validated by reconciling it against the source with SQL-based checks.
Data consumption: Ensures analysts and business users can query and visualize migrated data, keeping existing reports and analyses working.
Governance and quality: Partners with security and data governance teams to apply access control, privacy, lineage and data quality standards.
Stakeholder communication: Explains technical decisions, risks and progress to client technical and business stakeholders in clear, concise language.
Requirements:
Hands-on experience with Databricks, including Delta Lake.
Experience designing and executing data migrations between platforms.
Solid knowledge of AWS data services and cloud-native data architecture patterns, such as data lake and lakehouse.
Experience specifically managing data platforms, ETL pipelines, or analytics products.
Agile & Delivery: Strong experience leading cross-functional squads using Scrum/Kanban, backlog management tools (Jira, Linear), and defining clear user stories.
Data Skills: Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools, with the ability to query data directly to validate product performance and metrics.
Business Acumen: Demonstrated track record of converting complex technical requirements into actionable business outcomes and executive-ready communications.
Nice to Have:
Databricks Certified Consultant (Associate/Professional); DBR to EMR on AWS migration experience
AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or Pragmatic Institute Certification

descriptionBodyPlain:
As CI&T grows, we seek a talented, motivated, and experienced Data Developer to join our team and build robust data-driven solutions for our customers. This role is pivotal in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data infrastructure and pipelines that enable our data initiatives to thrive. 
The Data Developer will be responsible for implementing and optimizing data architectures, ensuring data quality and reliability, and collaborating closely with analytics and business teams to deliver high-performance data solutions. This position requires strong technical expertise in data engineering, cloud platforms, and modern data stack technologies, combined with the ability to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
Responsibilities:
Data Pipeline Development: Build, optimize, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support analytics and business intelligence needs.
Data Architecture Implementation: implement data architectures, including data lakes, warehouses, and integration layers that support the organization's data strategy and modernization.
Data Quality & Governance: Implement data quality checks, validation processes, and monitoring systems to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
Integration & API Development: Develop and maintain integrations between various data sources, third-party tools, and analytics platforms.
Collaboration: Work closely with Data & Analytics Managers and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver technical solutions that enable data-driven decision making.
Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance, query efficiency, and storage costs to ensure scalable and cost-effective solutions.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for data architectures, pipelines, and processes.
Data Security: Implement security best practices and ensure compliance with data privacy regulations across all data systems.
Powered by AI: Leverage AI tools and automation to enhance data engineering workflows and productivity.
 
Requirements:
Hands-on Databricks migration with the databricks/migrate tool (notebooks,
jobs, clusters, secrets, ACLs), Unity catalog to Glue Catalog
Notebook and job migration: notebooks, DAG pipelines, DLT pipelines
Storage path refactoring: /mnt/ DBFS references to S3-backed locations
Data migration execution: Deltalake format to Iceberg format on S3  (Delta tables, raw files), incremental sync
Streaming: Auto Loader / DLT checkpoint re-bootstrap, event_id dedup
Validation: row counts, checksums, sample queries, ETL runtime comparison
Secrets: recreate secret scopes in AWS Secrets Manager
AWS services: S3, Glue, Secrets Manager, IAM basics, Athena, LakeFormation and
EMR
Languages: Spark SQL, PySpark, Java, Python and Scala
Agile pod delivery: daily ticket updates, standups, code review
 
 
Nice to Have:
Databricks Certified Consultant (Associate/Professional); DBR to EMR on AWS migration experience

descriptionBodyPlain:
We are looking for an Observability Engineer to join our team and work for a large multinational company in the food and beverage sector. This is an opportunity to handle monitoring and system reliability in a high-scale, complex environment. If you have experience in SRE and are seeking challenges in large-scale operations, this is the role for you!

Position also available for Mid-Level Developers interested in transitioning to the SRE role.
If you're a developer who's already used to working on international projects, using English evryday, and wants to migrate to observability, this is the ideal place for you!


Responsibilities:
Performance Monitoring and Analysis: Monitor and analyze the performance of production systems, creating high-quality alerts to improve incident detection and prevention.
Preferred tools: AppDynamics (advantageous), New Relic, DataDog, Dynatrace, or similar.

Software Architecture Support: With prior experience in software development, understand the solution’s architecture and identify opportunities to enable monitoring and custom alerts.
Preferred languages: Java and/or Golang (not mandatory).

Troubleshooting: Investigate real-world production issues using reported metrics to identify root causes, collaborating with the application team.

Collaboration: Work closely with development teams to improve the reliability and performance of services.

Requirements for this challenge:
Practical experience with performance monitoring tools (AppDynamics is a plus, but New Relic, DataDog, or Dynatrace are also acceptable).
Background in software development, with a solid understanding of architecture and system integration.
Knowledge of programming languages such as Java and/or Golang (preferred, not mandatory).
Experience with SRE practices and DevOps culture.
Experience in troubleshooting and solving production issues.
Advanced oral and written communication skills in English. 


Nice to have:
Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, or other containerization technologies.
Knowledge of process automation and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

If you like it, just apply and good luck!

descriptionBodyPlain:
A CI&T busca uma pessoa desenvolvedora Fullstack Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de sistemas e processos, com foco em Java/Spring Boot, ReactJS, bancos de dados Oracle e PostgreSQL, e serviços em Google Cloud Platform (GCP). A posição possui atuação em processamento e integração de dados, incluindo sistemas regulatórios, desenvolvimento de soluções para grandes volumes de dados e integrações entre sistemas internos e serviços externos.
Responsabilidades:
Desenvolver e manter procedures, functions, packages e scripts PL/SQL em Oracle.
Desenvolver, manter e otimizar processos de banco de dados, incluindo consultas, cargas, processamento e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
Desenvolver e manter aplicações utilizando Java e Spring Boot.
Desenvolver serviços e processos utilizando PostgreSQL.
Implementar integrações assíncronas utilizando Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
Atuar em recursos da Google Cloud Platform (GCP) relacionados às aplicações e processos de integração.
Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs de terceiros: consumo de APIs REST, autenticação, tratamento de respostas/erros e mecanismos de reprocessamento.
Analisar e realizar troubleshooting de problemas em aplicações, integrações, APIs e processos de banco de dados.
Implementar adequações e novas funcionalidades conforme requisitos de negócio e regulatórios.
Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes, garantindo a continuidade e confiabilidade dos processos.
Requisitos para este desafio:
Experiência com desenvolvimento Java e Spring Boot.
Conhecimento sólido de Oracle e PL/SQL, incluindo procedures e packages.
Experiência com ReactJS para desenvolvimento frontend.
Experiência com PostgreSQL.
Conhecimento em mensageria e processamento assíncrono, especialmente Pub/Sub.
Experiência com integrações via APIs REST.
Conhecimento de ambientes cloud, especialmente GCP (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run).
Experiência com processamento de grandes volumes de dados.
Autonomia para analisar problemas de ponta a ponta, desde a camada de aplicação até banco de dados, mensageria e integrações externas.
Facilidade para trabalhar com sistemas existentes e compreender processos de negócio e regulatórios.
Versionamento com Git.
[Opcional] Diferenciais:
Conhecimento de sistemas e processos regulatórios, especialmente relacionados ao setor financeiro.

descriptionBodyPlain:
Project for a global pharmaceutical company: evolve a continuing education learning pathway library into an engagement platform for healthcare professionals outside field coverage — personalized, orchestrated in real time, and with professional recognition. Personalization depends on reliable data flowing between CRM (Veeva preferred), Data Lake, and Adobe Experience Platform, and on indicators showing whether the professional is returning. 2-year engagement, start planned for November 2026.
Position Mission
Build and operate the pipelines that feed and drain the data platform: from CRM and Data Lake to AEP and back, with measured quality, LGPD applied, and engagement indicators calculated reproducibly.
How the Role is Evaluated
Pipelines in production with monitoring, agreed update SLA and error rate.
Data quality rules defined and automatically verified (completeness, uniqueness, identity consistency).
Activation indicators, 7-day return, and active weeks calculated and reconciled with CJA.
No personal data outside legal basis: minimization, pseudonymization, and retention implemented by design.
Responsibilities
Design and implement ETL/ELT pipelines between CRM (Veeva preferred), Data Lake, and AEP (batch and streaming ingestion; profile, segment, and event export).
Model the platform's analytical tables in the Data Lake (Databricks) and calculate engagement and business indicators.
Implement data quality: testing, alerting, reconciliation across sources, identity deduplication handling.
Apply LGPD to data: classification, pseudonymization, retention and deletion policies, audit trail, fulfilling data subject requests.
Support the architect in XDM modeling and identity strategy from the source data perspective.
Document pipelines, data dictionary, and lineage; maintain operation runbooks.
Sustain pipelines in production and investigate data incidents.
Requirements
Mandatory:
Solid experience in data engineering, with production pipelines.
Advanced SQL, Python, and Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, jobs, and workflows).
CRM and Data Lake integration via APIs, connectors, and files; Veeva experience is a strong preference.
Data quality: automated testing, monitoring, reconciliation.
Metric calculation and governance (definition, versioning, reconciliation with analytics tools).
LGPD applied to personal data: minimization, pseudonymization, retention, data subject rights.
Native Portuguese and Advanced English for technical documentation.
Differentials:

AEP experience: ingestion (source connectors, batch and streaming APIs) and export (destinations, Data Landing Zone, Query Service).
Databricks or Adobe certifications.
Experience in pharmaceutical or healthcare sector.
Orchestration (Airflow, Databricks Workflows) and infrastructure as code.
Data modeling for personalization and recommendation.
#LI-TO1

text: [Job-32608] Senior Partner Sales Manager — Microsoft, US
descriptionBodyPlain:
We’re looking for someone who knows Microsoft from the inside. Not just someone who has worked with Microsoft — someone who understands how the organization operates, who the right people are, and how to move things forward in a co-sell motion. If that’s you, this role was built with your profile in mind.
As CI&T expands its partner ecosystem across North America, we’re opening a dedicated position to lead our Microsoft partnership. You’ll sit inside our North America Sales Machine, working at the intersection of CI&T’s account teams and Microsoft’s commercial and partner sales organization — with real influence over how this strategic relationship grows.

Your Mission
You’re the person who makes the Microsoft partnership produce results. That means identifying business opportunities where Microsoft technology fits into CI&T projects, activating co-sell motions, navigating funding programs (ECIF, MCI, ACO), and ensuring our account teams and Microsoft’s field are working together effectively. You’ll also coordinate joint events and marketing initiatives, and help shape CI&T’s partner strategy across key North America verticals — financial services, retail/CPG, healthcare, and automotive.
This is not a traditional sales role. CI&T’s account executives handle the commercial motion — you bring the partnership expertise, connect the right people, and make deals happen through the Microsoft ecosystem.

Must Have
Deep Microsoft experience — significant tenure inside Microsoft in a commercial, partner, or alliance-facing role. You know how the organization works, who to call, and how to get things done internally.
Partner or alliance background — proven experience in partner sales, partner development, alliances, or channel management. Titles like Partner Sales Manager, Partner Development Manager, Partner Account Manager, Alliances Manager, or Channel Manager.
Microsoft ecosystem fluency — hands-on knowledge of Microsoft’s partner programs, funding mechanisms (ECIF, MCI, ACO), and co-sell motion.
Commercial mindset — you identify opportunities and connect dots across organizations. Not a purely operational profile.
Fluent English — written and verbal.

Nice to Have
Experience at other hyperscalers (AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle, Databricks) in a partner-facing role
Background in a services or consulting organization
Vertical expertise in financial services, retail, CPG, healthcare, or automotive

Location & Travel
This is a fully remote position open to candidates based anywhere in the United States. Travel availability is required for partner events and Microsoft engagements. Candidates located in the Miami or Seattle areas are preferred, as these are home to Microsoft’s largest offices in the region.
 
If you like it, just apply and good luck!
#LI-JM2

descriptionBodyPlain:
Estamos buscando uma pessoa Architect Principal, para uma missão estratégica de altíssimo valor focada na modernização de sistemas legados (Mainframe) para a nuvem AWS, impulsionada pelo uso intensivo de Inteligência Artificial para ganho de eficiência no ciclo de desenvolvimento (SDLC).
A iniciativa tem como objetivo desenhar e implementar arquiteturas e soluções técnicas que garantam a escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência dos sistemas modernizados, suportando o crescimento e a evolução dos negócios do cliente.
A pessoa será a principal referência técnica e consultiva (Trusted Advisor) do projeto, responsável por liderar a transição do mundo Mainframe para o ecossistema distribuído na AWS, utilizando ferramentas como AWS Transform e agentes de IA para acelerar refatorações, testes e entregas.
Você irá liderar tecnicamente a esteira de modernização de legados para AWS, integrando e otimizando ferramentas de IA generativa no processo.
Será responsável por desenhar a arquitetura das soluções (Refactor), gerenciar riscos estruturais, garantir a governança de dados e promover o uso do estado da arte em IA no desenvolvimento de software.
É uma posição estratégica com forte viés hands-on, exigindo liderança inspiradora e capacidade de atuar desde o desenho de propostas técnicas e pré-vendas até a configuração de sistemas de agentes, resolução de problemas complexos e formação de times de alta performance.
 
Responsabilidades: 
Desenvolver soluções técnicas para problemas complexos de modernização de Mainframe (COBOL, CICS, DB2, VSAM) para AWS, promovendo inovação e alta qualidade.
Definir e implementar estratégias de governança de dados e arquitetura de sistemas, assegurando conformidade com normas de segurança.
Liderar o uso de IA, ferramentas como AWS Transform e agentes inteligentes no SDLC para trazer eficiência, automatizar refatorações e acelerar entregas (Kiro e Claude Code).
Configurar, personalizar e otimizar ferramentas e sistemas de agentes de IA para o contexto do contrato, garantindo a qualidade das saídas em ambiente de desenvolvimento.
Gerenciar riscos associados à arquitetura global de transição e atuar como ponto de escalonamento com key stakeholders.
Facilitar a comunicação e alinhamento entre executivos (C-Level), áreas de negócio e times de engenharia.
Definir métricas-chave do projeto e propor melhorias contínuas.
Estruturar, montar e liderar equipes de arquitetos e engenheiros de software (Engenharia de Software Ágil).
Formar outros arquitetos, mapeando talentos e planos de sucessão.
Atuar como Trusted Advisor, defendendo estratégias de tecnologia e traduzindo-as em impacto de negócio.
Garantir a uniformidade e consistência dos padrões de arquitetura e engenharia em todas as squads.
Participar ativamente do processo de pré-vendas, desenhando propostas técnicas e buscando a expansão de contratos e novos logos.
Requisitos:
Experiência em nível Principal/Especialista em Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência sólida e hands-on com AWS, arquitetura cloud e deployment de aplicações.
Forte experiência de desenvolvimento com React, Java e/ou Node.js.
Vivência real e comprovada em projetos de modernização de Legados/Mainframe (COBOL, JCL, CICS, DB2) para a nuvem.
Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes/EKS e arquiteturas baseadas em containers.
Conhecimento sólido de APIs, API Gateways, IAM, autenticação, autorização, secrets management e networking.
Experiência com CI/CD, automação de infraestrutura e Infrastructure as Code.
Conhecimento em uso de IA no desenvolvimento
Capacidade comprovada de configurar, integrar e otimizar ecossistemas de agentes de IA.
Conhecimento de arquiteturas modernas, sistemas distribuídos, microsserviços, eventos e filas.
Experiência com observabilidade, logging, métricas e tracing.
Capacidade de atuar da arquitetura à implementação e operação em produção.
Forte capacidade de troubleshooting e resolução de problemas complexos.
Capacidade analítica e senso crítico para avaliar alternativas técnicas, evitando complexidade desnecessária.
Boa comunicação para interação com Engenharia, Arquitetura, Segurança, Cloud, liderança técnica e clientes.
Diferenciais
Serão considerados diferenciais certificação AWS Solutions Architect Professional, experiência prática aprofundada com AWS Mainframe Modernization, AWS Transform e vivência consolidada na aplicação de Agentes de IA no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software (SDLC) para aceleração de migrações complexas.

descriptionBodyPlain:
We’re looking for a Dynamics 365 CRM Software Developer to join a dedicated nearshore team building a placement management platform for a US education client. The CRM core runs on Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, integrated with Azure services and a React frontend. You’ll build and extend the CRM layer and the Azure components around it.
 
What you’ll do
Customize Dynamics 365 and Dataverse: tables (entities), forms, views, business rules and Power Automate flows.
Develop C# plugins and custom workflow logic, following Dynamics best practices for performance and upgrades.
Configure Dataverse security, including security roles, business units, teams and field-level security.
Build Azure Function Apps that integrate with Dataverse, managed in Azure DevOps repos and deployed through Azure DevOps pipelines.
Work in an Agile team, overlapping with US Central Time.
 
What we’re looking for
Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 CE / Dataverse development, with production delivery.
Strong C# / .NET skills, including plugin development and the Dataverse SDK or Web API.
Practical experience with core Azure resources and concepts, especially Function Apps, plus CI/CD in Azure DevOps.
Experience managing solutions and moving them across environments (ALM).
Upper-intermediate or advanced English for daily communication with US stakeholders.
 
Nice to have
Experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Customer Insights – Journeys or Contact Center.
PCF components or Power Apps portals / Power Pages.
Certifications such as PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), MB-910 or AZ-204.

descriptionBodyPlain:
At CI&T, we imagine, design and build brands and digital experiences for top clients in financial services, consumer goods, healthcare, e-commerce and technology. Our philosophy is simple: quality work paves the way for trusted relationships.
As a System Architect in our development center in Brazil, you will design the end-to-end systems that power digital products for clients in the US. You will own how applications, infrastructure, networks and integrations fit together, so that solutions are secure, scalable, observable and cost-effective.
You will work hands-on with development, DevOps and security teams, and with client stakeholders from discovery through go-live. Advanced or fluent English is required, since you will communicate with international teams and clients throughout the workday.
Responsibilities:
- System design:Define the end-to-end architecture of solutions, covering applications, data, integrations, infrastructure and networking, with clear trade-offs on scalability, availability, performance and cost.
- Discovery and requirements: Take part in technology-focused discovery phases. Translate business and non-functional requirements into technical designs, and support pre-sales with solution proposals and estimates.
- Cloud and infrastructure: Design cloud environments (AWS, GCP or Azure), including networking, firewalls, routing, VPNs, virtualization and containers. Drive Infrastructure as Code adoption with tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
- DevOps and DevSecOps: Define CI/CD pipelines, branching strategies with Git, and package, image and container registries. Embed security practices and automated testing into the delivery flow.
- Observability and reliability: Set standards for monitoring, logging and alerting. Define SLOs, capacity plans and disaster recovery strategies.
- Cost management: Estimate infrastructure costs during design and monitor them in production, proposing optimizations as usage grows.
- Integrations:Design APIs and integrations with external systems such as CRMs, ERPs and partner platforms, ensuring interoperability and secure data exchange.
- Technical leadership: Guide and mentor engineers, review designs and code, and promote knowledge sharing across teams.
- Risk mitigation:Identify technical risks early, propose mitigation plans and alternative solutions.
- Documentation: Produce and maintain architecture diagrams, decision records and implementation guidelines, and explain them clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
Requirements:
- Solid knowledge of architecture patterns for distributed systems, microservices and cloud-native solutions.
- Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure).
- Experience with networking design: firewalls, routing, VPNs and load balancing.
- Experience with virtualization, Docker and containerized workloads.
- Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, Ansible or similar.
- DevOps or DevSecOps practices, including Git, CI/CD pipelines and artifact/container registries.
- Monitoring, logging and alerting tools (e.g. New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
- Experience estimating and monitoring infrastructure costs.
- Programming experience in at least one language such as Java, Python, JavaScript/Node.js or PHP.
- Experience with technology discovery phases and translating requirements into architecture.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders.
- Advanced or fluent English.
